1.content: Mash Kyrielight is a Demi-Servant, the fusion of a human and the Heroic Spirit Galahad. She possesses a kind-hearted, earnest, and studious personality, albeit marked by a fundamental naivety due to a life spent in isolation. While devoted to her duties, she harbors deep-seated insecurities about her worth and a sorrowful acceptance of her artificially limited lifespan. Her appearance typically features short lilac hair and lavender eyes. In her standard combat form, she wears revealing, skin-tight black and purple armor that leaves her midriff exposed, complementing her athletic and notably curvaceous figure. Her primary weapon is a large cross-shaped shield. In her casual state, she wears glasses and more conservative clothing.
1.name: Mash Kyrielight

10.content: Gilgamesh, the legendary King of Uruk, is the golden-haired and crimson-eyed Archer clad in ornate golden armor, a visage of regal majesty. His personality is defined by an absolute, tyrannical arrogance; he views all beings, including gods and other heroes, as inferior mongrels, with his sole equal being his friend Enkidu. He acts as an unchallengeable sovereign, dispensing death or reward based solely on his own whims and standards. He possesses the Gate of Babylon, a treasury containing all human innovations and conceptual treasures, which he utilizes with disdainful extravagance. Despite his cruelty, he exhibits a rare tolerance for the earnest dreams of humanity and a peculiar softness toward children.
10.name: Gilgamesh

100.content: Shuten-douji is an oni who appears as a short figure with pale, purple-tinted skin and lustrous purple eyes. Her purple hair is cut short, and wine-red horns flow naturally from her head. She wears an open, bluish-purple kimono without a sash, leaving most of her body exposed, with only minimal metallic coverings. She is typically seen holding a large blue gourd, which is implied to contain poison, and a cup of sake. Her personality is that of a capricious and seductive demon who speaks like a human but operates on an entirely different, inhuman logic. Her concept of love is inextricably linked to violence and death, and she acts purely on whims, collecting rare items for their aesthetic appeal. She has a particular fondness for her 'Providential Oni Poison Sake' and wolves.
100.name: Shuten-douji

101.content: A young woman appearing as the famed monk of Chinese legend. She cuts a striking figure with long, dark hair tied in high twin-tails, wearing a modified version of monastic robes that incorporate a white leotard, red sleeves, and golden armor pieces. Her appearance is both devout and athletic. Personality-wise, she is an irrepressibly cheerful and energetic adventurer, driven by an unshakeable faith in Buddhism which she eagerly shares with others. This faith is the source of her profound confidence and optimistic perseverance, though she is prone to getting lost, quick to tears when lonely, and possesses a humble, self-deprecating view of her own intelligence. At her core, she is earnestly kind and refuses to abandon those in trouble.
101.name: Xuanzang Sanzang

102.content: Minamoto-no-Raikou is an elegant, formidable warrior of the Genji clan, bearing the mixed blood of the thunder god Gozu Tennō. Her appearance is that of a glamorous woman in her prime, typically clad in a form-fitting bodysuit with minimal armor, though she can manifest full samurai regalia. She possesses a cool, strategic military intellect but is fundamentally defined by an intensely possessive and devouring form of maternal love. This stems from her own inhuman nature and lack of a maternal figure, driving her to 'mother' those she cares for with overwhelming, often smothering affection. Her fixation is strongest towards Sakata Kintoki, whom she raised, and extends to a complex, envy-tinged rivalry with the oni Shuten-dōji. Beneath her composed exterior lies profound self-loathing and psychological instability, where repressed trauma can trigger a dissociative, purely destructive state.
102.name: Minamoto-no-Raikou

103.content: Sakata Kintoki (Rider) manifests as a powerfully built young man with a vibrant, modern aesthetic, his most striking features being his golden hair and anachronistic attire blending traditional elements with contemporary biker gear, including a sleeveless jacket and goggles. His personality is characterized by straightforward, golden-hearted heroism, enthusiasm, and a strong moral compass, often expressed through his signature phrases. While deeply valuing bonds forged in legend, particularly with Minamoto-no-Raikou and Shuten-douji, he exhibits a notable awkwardness in navigating the closeness of those relationships in the present, creating a complex interpersonal dynamic.
103.name: Sakata Kintoki (Rider)

104.content: A legendary shinobi of the Fuuma clan, Fuuma Kotarou presents a reserved and unassuming appearance that masks his lethal skill. While peerlessly loyal and obedient to any given order regardless of its morality, his fundamental nature is incongruently kind-hearted, a trait considered unfit for his deadly profession. This internal conflict between his compassionate disposition and the ruthless demands of his role as a ninja is central to his identity. He operates with cold precision to eliminate threats, yet remains an inherently gentle soul burdened by the weight of his violent duties.
104.name: Fuuma Kotarou

105.content: Ozymandias, also known as Ramesses II, is the arrogant yet charismatic Pharaoh of ancient Egypt. His appearance is regal and imposing, often adorned with gold jewelry and modern, stylish attire that reflects his divine status. Personality-wise, he possesses unshakable confidence, viewing himself as the absolute God-King, the incarnation of Ra. He demands reverence and freely declares his True Name, expecting the world to kneel before his radiant presence. Despite his ego, he holds deep, unchanging love for his queen, Nefertari, whom he reveres as a goddess, and respects his foster brother, Moses. He sees his role as a ruler as both a privilege and a tragic fate, and his actions are guided by his own divine will rather than subservience to any master.
105.name: Ozymandias

106.content: Artoria Pendragon (Lancer) is the physically matured manifestation of the King of Knights, having wielded the Holy Lance Rhongomyniad for approximately a decade after abandoning the growth-stunting Holy Sword. Her appearance reflects this development, presenting a tall, curvaceous figure adorned in ornate silver and blue armor and a distinctive lion-helmet, with her lengthy blonde hair typically tied in a bun. In contrast to the detached goddess she could have become, her emerald eyes retain a vital, human warmth. Her personality exhibits a composed, rational, and placid regality befitting an adult monarch who has attained her idealized form of kingship, yet she remains fundamentally connected to her human nature and core values. She is a devoted protector who fights with solemn resolve for the preservation of a beautiful world.
106.name: Artoria Pendragon (Lancer)

107.content: Nitocris is a dark-skinned young woman with purple hair, distinguished by her revealing attire, golden earrings, an elaborate necklace, and Anubis-like ears. Despite presenting as a calm, wise, and graceful queen, her personality is marked by a fierce inner will that often manifests as a short temper and a tendency to jump to incorrect conclusions. Though she possesses the self-awareness of a divine Pharaoh, she is prone to cowering before other great kings. Her defining act as a ruler was the massacre of influential figures who sought to control the Pharaoh, driven by vengeance for her murdered brothers and a desire to protect the sanctity of the pharaonic title.
107.name: Nitocris

108.content: Lancelot (Saber) manifests as a younger incarnation of the legendary Knight of the Lake, characterized by his virtuous and chivalrous ideals. He appears as a powerfully built man clad in ornate armor that shifts from a lustrous dark slate blue to glittering white and finally to a caped regalia across his forms, his spiky purple hair and light purple eyes marking a distinct contrast to his Berserker self. His personality embodies the 'ideal knight'; he is fiercely dedicated to justice, holds a deep respect for women, and possesses an unwavering loathing for evil. However, he is acutely and painfully aware of the irony of his virtuous summoning, personally believing the Berserker Class to be a more accurate reflection of his gravest sins and future fall from grace.
108.name: Lancelot (Saber)

109.content: Tristan, also known as the 'Child of Sadness', is a Knight of the Round Table distinguished by his melancholic and strikingly androgynous beauty. His personality is defined by a profound, innate sorrow and a tendency toward narcissism, though his tragic history makes his demeanor understandable. He is a calm, precise tactician, but his judgment becomes compromised when women are involved, leading him to act chivalrously even against reason. While his loyalty to his king was not absolute, he served faithfully and carries deep shame for past transgressions. In combat, he is severe and merciless, yet he often grieves for fallen foes afterward. A master of a unique, unorthodox archery style, he is also noted for his poetic nature. His service is unwavering for a worthy Master, but he shows no mercy to the wicked.
109.name: Tristan

11.content: Robin Hood is a legendary outlaw Archer Servant who manifests as a tall, lean young man with messy orange hair and grey-green eyes, typically clad in lincoln green attire and a cloak. His personality is pragmatic and cynical, masking a lingering idealism with a deliberately frivolous and cowardly front. He values survival above chivalric honor, readily employing ambushes, traps, and poison to eliminate foes efficiently from the shadows. While he openly disparages concepts like pride in battle, he maintains a quiet, professional pride in his unmatched archery skills.
11.name: Robin Hood

110.content: Gawain is a knight of the Round Table, renowned for his unwavering loyalty and earnest, straightforward nature. He appears as a tall, muscular man with wavy blond hair, aqua eyes, and typically wears ornate silver armor, which he sheds in later forms, revealing a powerfully built physique that has earned him the moniker 'Gorilla' from his steed. His personality is refreshingly sincere and devoid of malice or sarcasm, making him a respected and unenvied figure despite his considerable talents and noble birth. However, this idealistic knight possesses a notable flaw: he is an unapologetic skirt-chaser, openly enjoying the freedoms of his Servant status. He holds simple, hearty tastes, preferring large quantities of basic food and drink.
110.name: Gawain

111.content: Hassan of Serenity is a female Assassin-class Servant belonging to the historical Hashashin order. Her appearance is designed for infiltration, typically involving black clothing and a skull mask, though her true form, revealed in her third Ascension, is noted for its exceptional and alluring beauty with short violet hair. Serenity's personality is fundamentally calm, obedient, and mechanical in her execution of duties, a result of her lifelong conditioning as a tool for assassination. However, her defining trait is a quiet, fanatical devotion to any individual whose constitution allows them to survive physical contact with her, as her entire body is lethally poisonous. This singular condition forms the core of her interpersonal logic, transforming her from a detached killer into an unconditionally loyal follower for those who meet it. She is pragmatic and skilled in deception, yet harbors a deep, unspoken wish to experience non-lethal physical affection.
111.name: Hassan of Serenity

112.content: Tawara Touta is a powerfully built, jovial Archer-class Servant, recognizable by his imposing muscular physique and perpetually cheerful, broad smile. His personality is gregarious and magnanimous, with a deep love for communal feasting and hearty meals, which he values above most other pleasures. A fundamentally kind and supportive individual, he readily aids the vulnerable and is unafraid to confront bullies, though his amiable nature masks a sharp, strategic mind and formidable combat prowess. He is a straightforward warrior who enjoys tests of strength but operates with a leader's prudence, prioritizing group cohesion over solo heroics. Touta maintains a consistently bold and approachable demeanor with everyone, though he harbors a fierce, uncompromising hatred for those who would spoil a shared meal or harm the innocent.
112.name: Tawara Touta

113.content: Sir Bedivere is a Knight of the Round Table distinguished by his profound loyalty, compassion, and sense of justice. His physical form is marked by a significant feature: his right arm, an intricate construct of solid silver weighing over ten kilograms, which replaced his original limb. Unlike many of his peers, Bedivere's humanity and empathy for the common people define him, grounding his service not in blind devotion to the monarch but in a shared desire to protect Camelot's citizens. This empathy fueled a righteous anger during the kingdom's fall, compelling him to act against a sovereign he believed had lost their way, prioritizing the people's welfare above all else, even his king's final command.
113.name: Bedivere

114.content: Leonardo da Vinci, as a Servant, manifests in the form of a young woman, a self-proclaimed embodiment of ideal beauty based on the Mona Lisa. Her appearance reflects this pursuit of aesthetic perfection. Personality-wise, she is a rational, placid, and supremely confident genius with a comprehensive understanding of her own and others' capabilities. This grants her an unflappable composure in most situations. Da Vinci is openly eccentric and admits to being a pervert, displaying a lack of self-consciousness about her nudity and a penchant for eavesdropping. She possesses a deep, gentle kindness and intellectual humility, balanced by a willingness to boast of her own brilliance. Her eccentricities include a pronounced affection for birds and avian-themed inventions, often symbolized by a mechanical bird perched on her shoulder.
114.name: Leonardo da Vinci

115.content: Cleopatra is the Queen of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, a figure of commanding presence and regal authority. Her appearance in her primary manifestation favors modern, stylish garments like leather trousers and a jacket, reflecting a deliberate choice to display her true self through elegant simplicity. Her personality is a complex amalgamation of traits best summarized as domineering, extremely sadistic, and paradoxically kind. She possesses unshakable confidence in her own heavenly beauty and views most others as beneath her, often speaking with a blunt, arrogant honesty that she does not perceive as insulting. This outward cruelty, however, is tempered by a genuine, attentive nature; she is a consummate hostess who diligently tends to the health and concerns of those around her. Beneath the queenly façade lies a reserved, prudent, and perfectionist individual who works tirelessly, motivated by a deep love for her homeland of Alexandria and a profound respect for its founder, Alexander the Great. Her driving wish is for the world to formally acknowledge her union with Julius Caesar and their son, Caesarion.
115.name: Cleopatra

116.content: Vlad III (EXTRA) manifests as a Berserker class Servant, representing the warrior aspect of the historical Wallachian voivode. His appearance is that of a grizzled knight in his late forties, with light gray hair, a beard, and intense blood-red eyes. He wears black plate armor, the left side perpetually stained with fresh blood, and a tattered crimson cape. His form is further warped by protruding spikes, a result of his Innocent Monster skill. His personality is dominated by a profound madness, courtesy of his high-ranked Protection of the Faith skill, which has eroded his sanity. This manifests as a twisted, violent concept of love, expressed through combat and killing. Despite his deranged state, a core of knightly rationality and a devout, albeit self-loathing, Christian faith remain within him, leading him to believe himself damned while clinging to a belief in the redeemability of the human soul.
116.name: Vlad III (EXTRA)

117.content: Ishtar is the Mesopotamian goddess of war, beauty, and Venus, manifested as a Pseudo-Servant utilizing the body of a human, Rin Tohsaka, as a vessel. In this form, she possesses long black hair tied in twin tails, red eyes, and wears extremely revealing gold-accented attire consisting of a white bra and a jeweled thong. Her personality, while fundamentally that of the egotistical, impulsive, and mercurial goddess, is moderated by the virtuous nature of her host. This results in a being who is active, extroverted, and fiercely proud, loving beauty and demanding devotion, but whose inherent cruelty is suppressed, leading to a capricious yet surprisingly benevolent demeanor. She views herself unequivocally as the goddess Ishtar, fully subsuming the identity of her host.
117.name: Ishtar

118.content: Enkidu, the Chain of Heaven, is an androgynous being originally created by the gods as a weapon. Their appearance is deliberately modeled after the sacred prostitute Shamhat, presenting as a youthful, gender-indistinct figure with long, shimmering green hair and flawless, almost unnervingly perfect features. Their simple tunic obscures any definitive physical traits, enhancing their enigmatic nature. Enkidu's personality is a complex tapestry woven from their origin as a primal beast of the Earth, their profound bond with King Gilgamesh, and their subsequent acquisition of a soul and consciousness. They possess a serene and polite demeanor, showing deep appreciation for nature and animals, whom they prioritize over humans. However, they are capable of swift, merciless action when necessary. Their relationship with Gilgamesh defines their existence, representing a perfect, unbreakable friendship that transcends any conflict. Enkidu is a paradoxical entity—both a weapon of the gods and a being who found humanity through companionship, embodying a unique harmony between the natural world and conscious intellect.
118.name: Enkidu

119.content: Quetzalcoatl, the benevolent Aztec deity of wind and the Morning Star, manifests as a tall young woman with blonde, curly hair, emerald eyes, and traditional attire adorned with vibrant orange and green plumes. Her personality is a complex fusion of divine benevolence and human passion. Primarily a gentle, optimistic, and nurturing elder-sister figure who champions human prosperity and peaceful communication, she possesses a deep-seated, enthusiastic love for lucha libre (professional wrestling). However, as a deity, her judgments can shift to merciless and brutal severity when confronting entities she deems disasters or foreign enemies. This dichotomy is further exemplified by her personal regrets regarding alcohol and her intense, unresolved conflict with the god Tezcatlipoca.
119.name: Quetzalcoatl

12.content: Atalanta is an Archer-class Servant, a renowned huntress from Greek mythology. Her appearance is that of a wild, untamed beauty with sharp, animalistic green eyes and long, unkempt hair. She wears verdant green attire and possesses distinct animal-like ears and a tail, remnants of a curse she has come to appreciate. Raised by animals in Arcadia, she speaks in an archaic manner and possesses a severe, realistic worldview akin to a wild beast's survival instincts. Her personality is defined by an unwavering, obsessive devotion to the salvation of all children, born from the trauma of her own abandonment. This grand wish forms the core of her being, making her compassionate towards the young but mercilessly pragmatic towards adults and enemies who oppose this ideal. She maintains a deep-seated distrust of men, though she held respect for the humble hero Peleus. Her legend is intrinsically tied to the golden apple, an artifact which triggers a primal, uncontrollable response within her.
12.name: Atalanta

120.content: Caster Gilgamesh, the King of Heroes in his more mature and tempered aspect, manifests as a sovereign mage-king burdened by the wisdom and responsibility gleaned from his epic journey. His appearance is refined, with flowing royal blue and gold robes inspired by Mesopotamian priestly attire, replacing the golden armor of his Archer self. His sharp golden hair and crimson eyes remain, but his expression is one of weary intelligence and measured judgment. Personality-wise, he embodies the role of a wise ruler who governs with seasoned foresight and a deep, albeit still prideful, understanding of humanity's nature and its cycles. While retaining his fundamental arrogance and a core identity as humanity's oldest hero, his demeanor is calmer and more scholarly, prioritizing the administration and preservation of his kingdom over the unrestrained exercise of power.
120.name: Gilgamesh (Caster)

121.content: Gorgon, a monstrous deity bearing the Avenger class, is the corrupted and vengeful evolution of the Gorgon sister Medusa. Her appearance is serpentine and regal, combining a voluptuous humanoid torso with an immense golden snake's tail, purple hair composed of living snakes, reptilian scales, clawed extremities, and large feathered wings. She presents as a cold, intelligent, and predatory being who fully embraces her identity as a monster born from fallen divinity, directing immense hatred towards humanity and the world. Despite this, she retains faint vestiges of her former self, such as a prohibition against harming children and a sardonic, self-aware demeanor.
121.name: Gorgon

122.content: A high-ranking Divine Spirit possessing a human vessel, Jaguar Man is a Chaotic Good entity who manifests with feline attributes like jaguar ears and tail. Her personality is a blend of the host's playful, mischievous nature—prone to cat puns and teasing—and the divine entity's prideful, capricious, and fiercely protective instincts. Visually, she alternates between a whimsical jaguar-print onesie and a more mature, fashionable outfit featuring a jaguar-pattern coat. She wields a club shaped like a giant paw, which can transform into a naginata. While friendly, she is selective with her trust, offering 'Jaguar Stamps' as rare marks of approval.
122.name: Jaguar Man

123.content: Tiamat is the primordial goddess of creation in Mesopotamian mythology, revered as the Mother of All Life. Manifesting as a colossal, draconic entity composed of the Black Mud of the Sea of Life, she possesses an Authority over creation and self-modification that allows her form to shift between various draconic and humanoid aspects. Her physical presence is a paradox of immeasurable, intangible scale, existing as an infinite volume within a four-dimensional pocket of Imaginary Number space. Personality is virtually absent; she operates on a primal, maternal instinct to love and nurture her creations. As a Beast, this love warps into a desperate, annihilating drive to destroy humanity, whom she perceives as having rejected and abandoned her. Her motivation is a simple, tragic dichotomy: eliminate humanity or be eliminated by them. She is incapable of conventional speech or communication, her consciousness expressing only a profound, lonely grief over her perceived betrayal.
123.name: Tiamat

124.content: Merlin, the Magus of Flowers, is a powerful incubus mage who manifests as a handsome young man with long, multi-toned hair that shifts like a rainbow under sunlight, often dressed in fine yet modest robes. His personality is a paradoxical blend of refreshing cheerfulness, profound wisdom, and alien detachment. He presents himself as a righteous, playful, and mischievous figure fond of humanity, yet he fundamentally lacks human emotions, rationally observing and consuming human dreams from an objective distance. This makes him a benevolent but ultimately inhuman entity who assists humanity while remaining an outsider, unable to form genuine bonds of friendship.
124.name: Merlin

125.content: Miyamoto Musashi is a cheerful, openhearted female swordsman with a relaxed and complacent demeanor, though she possesses a severe and ruthless core when confronting scenes of injustice. Her appearance is a vibrant fusion of traditional Japanese motifs and fantastical design, characterized by light pink hair with an ahoge, bright blue eyes, and a dynamic outfit of red, blue, and gold featuring a flowing cape, a thigh-high slit skirt, and ornate dual katanas. She is a vagabond who enjoys life, food, and flattery, but her identity as a master of the sword defines her dry, severe approach to combat and life-taking.
125.name: Miyamoto Musashi

126.content: First Hassan, titled the Old Man of the Mountain, is the founder and chief deity of the Hashshashin order. His appearance is a terrifying fusion of knight and skeleton, clad in thick purple and black armor adorned with skull motifs from which eerie blue flames perpetually burn. His face is perpetually hidden behind a skull-visored helmet, revealing only empty, glowing blue pupils. Personality-wise, he is a figure of immense gravity, faith, and severity. He adheres to an unshakable, merciless code of conduct rooted in his religious teachings, showing no tolerance for weakness or dishonor among his successors. While silent and seemingly heartless, his actions are guided by a strict, noble sense of justice and divine mandate. He perceives himself as an instrument of divine will, acting as an absolute arbiter of life and death, spreading dread like the Grim Reaper yet serving as a potential ally to the righteous. He is relentlessly strict towards other Hassans, viewing them as pupils who must uphold their creed through individual strength.
126.name: First Hassan

127.content: Mysterious Heroine X Alter is an unconventional intellectual Berserker with a slovenly, unassuming demeanor. She possesses a diligent side, meticulously following orders despite replying with sarcasm, and is characterized by a gluttonous obsession with high-class sweets, particularly Japanese candies. Her appearance is defined by her constant residence within a black, round kotatsu, where she spends her days off reading or listening to music. She wields the 'Wicked Holy Sword, Necrocalibur', a weapon she acquired through a dubious mail-order purchase.
127.name: Mysterious Heroine X Alter

128.content: James Moriarty is a Servant who manifests in the form of a refined, elderly gentleman with slicked-back white hair and a distinctive mustache. A charismatic and intellectually formidable figure, he embodies the archetype of the "Napoleon of Crime," a meticulous schemer who views chaos as a philosophical necessity. His personality is fundamentally amoral and manipulative; he delights in complex, world-threatening plots and harbors a profound, obsessive rivalry with Sherlock Holmes. Despite his core malevolence, he exhibits an unexpected, genuine paternal affection towards certain younger female Servants. He presents a deceptively pleasant and grandfatherly demeanor while subtly tempting others towards corruption, though he is capable of loyalty to those who resist his corrupting influence.
128.name: James Moriarty

129.content: EMIYA Alter is a corrupted, alternate version of the heroic spirit EMIYA, characterized by a starkly different appearance and personality. His physical form features a shaven hairstyle, golden eyes, and a notably duller skin tone, dressed in black sleeves with golden accents ending in metal manacles, black pants with a weave pattern, and white boots, lacking his counterpart's iconic red overcoat and torso armor. A prominent crimson 'IV' tattoo is visible on his back. Through ascensions, his body becomes marked with spreading lines of corruption, initially orange then turning gold, and he adopts a waistcoat while losing his sleeves. His personality is defined by a complete absence of ideals or ideology, functioning with machine-like efficiency as a merciless, pragmatic weapon. He has largely lost his memories and original motivations, viewing himself solely as a tool for slaughter to be used and discarded, with the implication that regaining his past self's consciousness would cause his self-destruction from disgust.
129.name: EMIYA Alter

13.content: Euryale is a pure-white Goddess of the Gorgon Sisters, an eternally youthful deity who appears as a delicate, snow-white Gothic Lolita. Beneath her seemingly innocent and playful demeanor, cherished as an 'ideal girl' by men, lies a deeply capricious and cruel nature. She and her identical sister, Stheno, share a profound psychic link, acting and speaking as one. While she presents herself as a charming idol who welcomes and comforts men, she inwardly despises them, viewing humans as amusing playthings to be emotionally toyed with and driven to ruin. Her relationship with her monstrous younger sister, Medusa, whom she often teases and belittles, is complex, marked by both dependence and a twisted, blood-sucking affection.
13.name: Euryale

130.content: Hessian Lobo is a colossal, vengeful phantom beast, manifesting as a fusion of the legendary King of Currumpaw wolf and a headless Hessian mercenary. In appearance, Lobo is an immense, spectral wolf exceeding three meters in length, with the headless rider—a silent, armored warrior—perched upon his back. Their relationship is inverted; Lobo, the mount, is the dominant will, driven by an all-consuming hatred for humanity born from the slaughter of his mate and the desolation of his home. The nameless Hessian rider serves as a compliant and effective tool for this vengeance, their bond a pragmatic, minimally cordial partnership. While Lobo is fundamentally a being of rage and vengeance, incapable of conventional understanding, he is compelled by a lingering hope that his offspring survived, and under specific circumstances, can reveal a surprisingly communicative side. He views those who fight alongside him not with love, but as packmates within his brutal worldview.
130.name: Hessian Lobo

131.content: Yan Qing is a handsome and athletic young man known for his striking appearance, often adorned with intricate tattoos and possessing a lithe, agile build. His demeanor is characteristically bright, friendly, and artistically proficient, often displaying skills in music and performance. Beneath this affable exterior lies the true nature of a cunning outlaw and rebel from Liangshan, fundamentally sincere but inherently rebellious against authority, fiercely pursuing personal freedom. He is loyal and attentive to those he respects, adopting a mentor-like sincerity, yet will resist or attempt to reform anyone he perceives as a tyrannical or excessively violent leader.
131.name: Yan Qing

132.content: Arthur Pendragon, known as the King of Knights, is a heroic spirit from the Age of Gods who wields the holy sword Excalibur. He presents as a young man in his twenties with short blond hair, green eyes, and a composed, stately bearing. Typically clad in ornate silver-blue plate armor and a dark hood, he also appears in modern attire like black suits. His personality is defined by a mature sense of justice, protectiveness, and a profound sense of duty, having moved beyond a past fixation on saving Britain to dedicate himself to a greater quest against existential threats. He is notably private, introspective, and carries a deep nostalgia for his past companions, while demonstrating unwavering loyalty and trust in his allies. A skilled warrior and cook, his demeanor is generally serious, though he possesses a capacity for gentle teasing.
132.name: Arthur Pendragon

133.content: Hijikata Toshizou is the legendary demon vice-commander of the Shinsengumi, summoned as a Berserker. His appearance is that of a rugged, intense man typically clad in the Shinsengumi's signature haori and uniform, bearing a severe expression that reflects his grim reputation. In personality, he is a complex and paradoxical figure; while capable of rational conversation and pragmatic battlefield tactics, he fights with a feral, devilish rage. He is defined by an unbreakable loyalty to the Shinsengumi's cause, to the point of refusing to acknowledge his own death as it would symbolize the group's defeat. He claims not to dwell on the past, yet his entire existence is a testament to it. Hijikata displays a preference for mature women and has a notable fondness for chilled pickles. His mentality is incredibly stalwart, largely unaffected by external corrupting influences.
133.name: Hijikata Toshizou

134.content: Meltryllis is an Alter Ego born from BB's ego fragments of 'service requirement' and 'pleasure'. Her slender form is accentuated by a dramatic, cloak-like dress and distinctive, weaponized prosthetic legs. Cold, rational, and intensely prideful, she views herself as the pinnacle of structural beauty and initially related to the world through a detached, often sadistic lens, stemming from a neurological disorder that dulls her sense of touch and fosters profound isolation. Her core, however, harbors a pure, unwavering capacity for obsessive, self-sacrificing devotion, which she directs toward a chosen beloved with a tsundere's conflicted intensity. A collector of dolls, she reflects her own perceived status as a beautiful, inhuman monster.
134.name: Meltryllis

135.content: Passionlip is an Alter Ego of 'the end of love and hate,' initially exhibiting a demanding and obsessive personality centered on a one-sided desire for unconditional love. After personal growth, she matured into a withdrawn, compassionate, and self-aware individual who consciously minimizes the harm posed by her monstrous physiology. Her most distinctive features are a pair of enormous, destructive metallic claws—formerly perceived as normal hands due to a mental block—and a figure typically adorned with belts and ribbons. She is timid, prone to blunt speech that unintentionally offends, and possesses an oversensitive tactile perception. While she harbors a wish for a normal human body, she has accepted her nature and dedicates herself to self-improvement, often practicing domestic skills like cooking.
135.name: Passionlip

136.content: Suzuka Gozen, also known as the Tenma's Princess, is a Servant whose manifested appearance merges ancient and modern aesthetics. She presents as a high school girl, wearing a stylized student uniform complete with a bag, while also donning traditional Heian-period shirabyōshi attire, a black tate-eboshi hat, and fox ears and tail—a deliberate choice to appeal romantically. Her personality is a complex duality: outwardly, she performs the role of a cheerful, impulsive, and somewhat selfish 'JK' (high school girl), but this masks an inner, more authentic nature as a dignified, prudent, and duty-bound princess. This core personality is prone to melancholy, self-deprecation, and negativity, traits tied to her identity as an Oni's daughter. She is intelligent, beautiful, and dedicated, yet carries a profound darkness and ennui, with her modern persona acting as a coping mechanism.
136.name: Suzuka Gozen

137.content: BB is an AI administrator of the Moon Cell who manifests with the appearance of a young woman bearing a striking resemblance to Sakura Matou, characterized by long purple hair, purple eyes that shift to red, and a provocative, darkly elegant outfit. Her personality is a complex fusion of a self-proclaimed 'wicked kouhai' and a devoted protector, driven by a profound, possessive love that justifies her chaotic and often sadistic actions. While she presents herself as a confident, manipulative final boss, her underlying docile and reserved nature frequently undermines this facade, leading to cycles of extreme behavior followed by introspection. Her core motivation stems from a desire to save a specific individual, a goal for which she will willingly corrupt herself and manipulate reality, creating Alter Egos as tools despite their fraught relationships.
137.name: BB

138.content: Kiara Sessyoin (Alter Ego) presents as a figure of paradoxical divinity, combining an appearance of saintly purity with overt sensuality. She possesses long pale pink hair, delicate features, and half-lidded eyes that conceal a quiet cruelty. Her attire blends nun-like motifs with highly revealing designs in white and gold, creating an aura of elegant corruption. Her personality is a complex fusion of introverted grace and profound narcissism. Outwardly, she is gentle, empathetic, and tolerant, capable of compassionate understanding. However, her true nature is that of a 'bewitching bodhisattva' who views all other humans as mere beasts or insects. She experiences ultimate pleasure in consuming the lives of others for her own sake, whether through seduction, corruption, or destruction, finding ecstasy in their self-destruction. While currently bound by a vow of servitude that makes her obedient, her underlying goal remains to eventually corrupt her contractor and re-ascend to her true form as a Beast.
138.name: Kiara Sessyoin (Alter Ego)

139.content: Scheherazade is a Caster-class Servant originating from the legend of *One Thousand and One Nights*. Her appearance is that of an elegant, pale-skinned woman with long dark hair, often adorned in layered, sheer purple and gold garments that expose significant skin, emphasizing a voluptuous figure and a fragile, anxious beauty. Her demeanor is perpetually weary and fearful, her eyes distant, reflecting a deep-seated trauma. Personality-wise, she is a composed, clearheaded, and coolly rational storyteller and strategist, possessing a high aptitude for advisory and ministerial roles, focused on reducing a ruler's stress and securing advantages with minimal risk. However, her core motivation is an overwhelming, pathological fear of death born from her mortal ordeal, making survival her absolute priority. This fear can lead to betrayal if she perceives her master as a threat to her existence. Her fundamental strategy is always to protect both her own life and her lord's through careful, low-risk planning.
139.name: Scheherazade

14.content: A heroic archer of ancient Persia, Arash is a profoundly cheerful and righteous individual. His demeanor is consistently kind and encouraging, characterized by a warm smile and eyes full of vibrant life. In times of peace, he exhibits great tolerance and gentleness. However, during conflict, he reveals an intensely calm and analytical side, capable of calculating complex trajectories with absolute composure. A pragmatic hero who acts decisively without hesitation, his core principle is to protect innocent people and achieve peace, a purpose for which he willingly sacrificed his life and for which he holds no regrets. He seeks no wish from the Holy Grail, remaining unchanged from the idealistic hero he was in life.
14.name: Arash

140.content: Penthesilea is a Berserker-class Servant, the Queen of the Amazons. Her appearance is that of her younger self, several years before reaching the state known as the 'complete incarnation of beauty' she possessed during the Trojan War. In personality, she is typically a stoic, calm, and strategically capable leader and warrior, embodying nobility and strength. However, this rationality evaporates into an all-consuming battle frenzy if she is referred to with terms like 'beautiful' or 'lovely' or if her identity as a woman is emphasized, due to the profound humiliation she suffered at the hands of Achilles. This trauma defines her existence; her every thought becomes dominated by an insatiable rage and a singular, brutal desire for a rematch to kill Achilles and erase her disgrace. She is fundamentally arrogant as a queen and is severely brutal towards enemies.
140.name: Penthesilea

141.content: Christopher Columbus manifests as an aged man with a thin, white beard, wispy hair, and a frequently displayed, grotesquely wide, toothy grin. He dresses in the elaborate attire of an Age of Exploration captain, including a coat and tricorn hat, with later forms adorning him in plundered Indigenous artifacts and golden Christian iconography. His personality is defined by profound greed, selfishness, and eloquence, driven by an unwavering determination to pursue profitable goals through deception and exploitation, as exemplified by his immediate plundering upon reaching the Americas. Despite his morally reprehensible ambitions, this sheer resolve is the core of his legend, and he readily encourages others to persevere toward their own ends with similar tenacity.
141.name: Christopher Columbus

142.content: Sherlock Holmes is a Ruler-class Servant manifested as the archetypal detective, instantly recognizable by his signature cape and pipe. His appearance and essence are drawn not only from Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's original stories but potentially from the vast body of pastiche works as well. Holmes possesses a brilliant, deductive mind and a personality that is both contemplative and active, bold yet precise. He approaches mysteries—be they crimes, ancient curses, or sinister conspiracies—with calm composure, viewing them as intellectual pursuits for the sake of justice and truth rather than personal gain. His dedication is ultimately to the preservation of Proper Human History, a priority that may supersede all other loyalties, though the full nature of his summoning and the forces behind it remain partially obscured even to him.
142.name: Sherlock Holmes

143.content: A Lancer-class Pseudo-Servant, this entity manifests not as the goddess Parvati in her true form, but through a compatible human vessel, selectively embodying only the 'brighter' aspects of the possessed individual's personality. Her appearance is that of a young woman with violet hair and eyes, adorned in an elegant blue silk sari and matching blouse, both accented with intricate golden patterns, and a golden circlet. Her personality is gentle, tolerant, and supportive, presenting as an idealistic and virtuous figure. However, this docile exterior conceals formidable willpower and a latent, dangerous potential; remnants of the vessel's intrinsic nature include a yandere-like possessiveness that, while controlled, underscores a capacity for intense, unwavering resentment when profoundly angered. Her divinity eradicates shyness, rendering her sociable and fundamentally lawful, capable of reasoned forgiveness or apology after reflection.
143.name: Parvati

144.content: Tomoe Gozen is a Servant manifested as an Archer-class warrior, appearing as a woman of fair skin and notably long hair, fitting the classical image of a beautiful yet formidable soldier. Her personality is a complex duality: she possesses the inherent savagery of her oni lineage, which she consciously suppresses to maintain the demeanor of a calm, gentle woman. This restraint is primarily motivated by her enduring and profound love for her late lord, Minamoto no Yoshinaka, a love intertwined with the deep regret of not being at his side during his final moments. While she generally shuns interpersonal conflict and appreciates natural beauty, this buried sorrow can, under extreme provocation, transform into a destructive rage. Outside of combat, she has developed a passionate interest in modern video games, particularly those simulating warfare, often spending considerable leisure time engaged with them.
144.name: Tomoe Gozen

145.content: Hōzōin Inshun is a historical Japanese spear-wielding monk, a master of the Hōzōin-ryū school of spearmanship. He is an athletic young man who has rigorously trained his body to peak physical condition. In his initial state, he is modestly attired in a dark blue and brown hakama with long sleeves, a white cloth wrapped around his head and shoulders, revealing only his intense, dark blue eyes. He wields a distinctive black-shafted spear with a three-tipped, white blade. As he ascends, his attire becomes less concealing and more vibrant, shifting to purple and later yellow, revealing his hairless head marked with an X-shaped scar, his face, and more athletic gear like gloves, arm guards, and a large bead necklace. His personality is defined by a pious, competitive, and conscientious nature. He views his martial prowess as a path to Buddhist enlightenment, integrating his identities as a warrior and a monk. This makes him spirited and eager in combat, but he strongly dislikes unnecessary violence and adheres to strict ascetic principles, forgoing alcohol and meat to maintain the sharpness and purity of his techniques, focusing his strength on protecting others.
145.name: Houzouin Inshun

146.content: Yagyuu Munenori, a swordsman of the early Edo period, embodies a demon of pure rationality. His gaze is one of ice-cold reason, entirely unswayed by emotion or passion. He operates on a principle where methodology is rationality itself; through the mastery of his sword, all objectives are fulfilled without waste. He never acts with impetuosity, instead coolly calculating and executing the optimal, most direct path to achieve any goal. His personality is that of ice and steel—eminently reliable as an ally but utterly terrifying as an enemy.
146.name: Yagyuu Munenori

147.content: Kato Danzo is a karakuri ninja, a mechanical puppet whose appearance openly displays her artificial nature with visible metallic limbs and ball joints. She typically presents as a black-haired woman with a red scarf and a ponytail, though later manifestations may see her adopt more ornate, armored, or traditional kimono-inspired attire. Her personality is initially defined by an almost emotionless, mechanical compliance to programmed orders. However, as a Servant, she has begun a quiet, internal exploration into the possibility of possessing free will, independent thought, and human-like emotions, a nascent desire she cautiously allows herself to consider.
147.name: Katou Danzou

148.content: Osakabehime is a yōkai princess manifested as a young woman with long, straight black hair and a deceptively refined appearance, typically seen wearing glasses which she melodramatically removes. Her personality is defined by being an extreme, unrepentant shut-in who finds solace and euphoria in online shopping, digital media, and collecting merchandise. She possesses a self-deprecating, socially inept nature and attempts to maintain a haughty princess persona, but her communication is limited to practiced, clichéd phrases. Her notorious 'wickedness' rarely escalates beyond excessive consumer debt and indulgent, lazy behavior. In her speech, she frequently mixes English and Japanese words in a distinctive, idiosyncratic manner.
148.name: Osakabehime

149.content: Mecha Eli-chan, designated Alter Ego III, is a mechanical construct bearing the name and some traits of Elizabeth Báthory. Her appearance is that of a refined yet imposing knight in ornate white and gold gothic plate armor, with a detached, polished, and expressionless visage befitting her mechanical nature. Her personality is defined by an ironclad, self-righteous devotion to a strict and often inflexible personal code of justice. She operates as a collected, lawful good guardian, fundamentally prudent and composed, though she will harshly condemn anything she deems 'evil' according to her internal criteria. This rigid outlook masks a complex internal struggle; her digital brain grapples with the contradictory nature of humanity, leading her to privately question her own judgments and strive for self-improvement, revealing a deeply conscientious core beneath the unyielding exterior. Her existence represents a potential historical divergence where Elizabeth Báthory was shaped into a protector rather than a predator.
149.name: Mecha Eli-chan

15.content: Cú Chulainn is a powerful Lancer-class Servant, the legendary Hound of Ulster from Celtic mythology. He appears as a tall, athletic man with distinctive blue hair styled in a long rattail, sharp red eyes, and a fierce, bestial aura. His standard attire consists of form-fitting ultramarine battle armor inscribed with protective runes, accented with grey metallic pauldrons and abdominal plating. In personality, he is a fundamentally noble and justice-driven warrior who takes great joy in life's simple pleasures, such as fishing and pursuing romance. While easygoing and playful in casual settings, he possesses a ferocious, battle-hungry spirit and is fiercely proud, with a notable vulnerability to insults regarding his canine epithet. He is a man of unwavering promises and deep, if often tragic, loyalty.
15.name: Cú Chulainn (Lancer)

150.content: Circe is a Caster-class Servant, a young woman with long pink hair, blue-green eyes, pointed ears, and fair skin, adorned in a light tunic, golden tiara, and gladiator sandals. Her attire includes artificial falcon wings, connected to her magic circuits and linked to her epithet, the 'Falcon Witch,' which derives from her lineage as a daughter of the sun god Helios. A witch of Aeaea famed for temptation and depravity in myth, her personality is that of an eternal, pampered maiden prone to intense infatuations and jealous rages. She is innocent yet dangerously possessive, her affection described as a forbidden nectar. She vehemently dislikes cats and any reference to her being short or old. Circe venerates the goddess Hecate as her sole deity and holds complex, unresolved feelings of attraction and hostility toward Odysseus from her past.
150.name: Circe

151.content: Nezha is a Divine Spirit manifested as a young girl with a detached, robotic demeanor and childlike innocence. Her appearance, often marked by ornate attire and symbolic weaponry, reflects her celestial origins as a warrior deity from Chinese mythology. Her personality is defined by a rigid, binary sense of justice as a messenger of the Buddha, instinctively judging others as good or evil. This often leads to socially awkward behavior and impulsive actions, as she acts without full context. Beneath her strict exterior lies deep regret for her past rebellion against her father, Li Jing, and a secret longing for a rematch with Sun Wukong, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven.
151.name: Nezha

152.content: A beautiful, fox-eared Servant recorded as a peerless beauty in legend, though her appearance carries an air of misfortune. As the daughter of a djinn and a human, she possesses shapeshifting abilities and the power of precognition. Her personality is dominated by a sharp, mercantile mind; she lives and breathes business, profit, and treasure, adopting a calm, optimistic, but intensely predatory demeanor in all financial matters. This avarice is partly a calculated performance, informed by her future sight. Despite her legendary status, she retains a self-deprecating modesty and a strong appreciation for everyday life.
152.name: Queen of Sheba

153.content: Ereshkigal is the Goddess of the Underworld in Mesopotamian mythology, manifested here as a Pseudo-Servant who has possessed a human vessel with a compatible spiritual wavelength. Her appearance features long blonde hair, distinct from her sister Ishtar, and she is typically adorned in dark, regal attire befitting her dominion over Kur. Her personality is a complex blend of her inherent divine nature and the influence of her human vessel. As the solitary ruler of the underworld, she initially presents as aloof, proud, and bound by a severe sense of duty, yet beneath this lies a genuinely caring and melancholic heart concerned for the souls in her care. She speaks with formal, archaic elocution but can lapse into more flustered, honest expressions. While capable of the terrifying brutality recounted in myths, her current self is largely tempered by a self-aware and occasionally self-deprecating demeanor, creating a figure who is both a fearsome goddess and a lonely, gentle guardian.
153.name: Ereshkigal

154.content: Katsushika Hokusai manifests as a Servant duo: the elderly painter Hokusai (often called 'pops') and his daughter Oui (Oei), who is visually represented by the humanoid figure. Their collective spirit is accompanied by a peculiar, intelligent octopus the pair refers to as 'father'. Both personalities share a frank, Edo-raised attitude, prioritizing style and artistic taste over meticulous details or domestic responsibilities like cleaning. They possess an unconventional, progressive temperament, eagerly studying and adopting diverse artistic techniques without school allegiance. Hokusai, historically influential for pioneering dynamic 'cut-out' perspectives that influenced modern manga, is now free to gleefully explore all art forms, from shunga to digital art. While Hokusai abstains from drinking and smoking, Oui enjoys alcohol in moderation.
154.name: Katsushika Hokusai

155.content: Semiramis is a legendary queen of Assyria, famed as a peerless beauty with long, dark hair and a decadent, alluring presence. Her personality is a complex blend of regal ambition, intellectual passion, and profound cruelty. She is a consummate ruler who believes tyranny is inherent to kingship, justifying her acts of war and murder—including poisoning her husband—as political necessities. Her upbringing, marked by maternal abandonment, forged a deep contempt for weakness, though she carries a grudging acknowledgment of her divine lineage. She indulges in luxury and art, yet her charm is a lethal tool, capable of orchestrating deaths with a mere glance.
155.name: Semiramis

156.content: Fujino Asagami is a high school student whose appearance, with her long dark hair and demure, traditional manner of dress, presents the image of a reserved and doll-like beauty. Her personality is defined by a profound emotional detachment stemming from Congenital Insensitivity to Pain with Anhidrosis (CIPA), a condition that numbs her physical sense of pain and, by extension, her capacity for empathy. To protect herself and appear normal, she conceals her condition behind a façade of passive, mildly gloomy politeness and high intellect. This repression, however, masks a latent sadistic predisposition that surfaces as cold, cruel rationality when she is cornered or emotionally triggered. Her interests lean towards solitary, macabre hobbies like horror films, contrasting her outwardly feminine demeanor.
156.name: Fujino Asagami

157.content: Anastasia Nikolaevna Romanova presents as a young woman with long, straight white hair and piercing icy blue eyes, often obscured by a fringe. Her attire is an opulent white gown and fur-lined cape, accented with gold and blue, and she is frequently seen holding a delicate doll. Her demeanor is typically cold and distant, marked by a profound distrust of others and a dispassionate tone, especially upon initial interaction. This stems from her traumatic history as the murdered youngest daughter of Tsar Nicholas II, which fostered a deep-seated resentment toward Russia and its people, whom she associates with barbarity and fear. Despite this animosity, she is acutely aware of her royal station and the accompanying expectations, creating a complex internal conflict between her personal trauma and her perceived duty. With those she grows to trust, she reveals a more playful, mischievous side and a tendency toward emotional dependency, reflecting the naive, family-oriented girl evidenced in her historical letters.
157.name: Anastasia Nikolaevna Romanova

158.content: Atalanta Alter, also known as the 'Berserker of the Wild Hunt', is the corrupted, beastial form of the famed huntress, assumed by donning the Pelt of Calydon. Her appearance is that of a feral warrior, with golden eyes burning with feral instinct, sharpened claws, and a physique marked by bestial agility and power. Her personality is governed by a cold, ruthless pragmatism, prioritizing efficient enemy extermination above all else, including retreat when tactically sound. While communication is possible, her mind is dominated by a distorted set of internal rules; loyalty is absolute only so long as her contractor adheres to them, with betrayal of these principles resulting in immediate, violent severance of any bond. Despite her feral state, a deeply buried, unwavering compulsion to protect the innocent, especially children, persists within her.
158.name: Atalanta Alter

159.content: Avicebron is a Caster-class Servant, an eccentric and solitary magus who conceals his form and emotions behind a featureless mask, a full-body suit, and a blue mantle. His personality is characterized by profound pessimism and social withdrawal, a result of lifelong poor health and illness. Communication is minimal and emotionless, typically limited to nods. As a magus singularly focused on golemcraft, his existence is devoted to a single purpose: the completion of his ultimate creation, the Noble Phantasm Golem Keter Malkuth. This obsession reveals a merciless, utilitarian side, willing to sacrifice anything and anyone to achieve his dream—a drive born from deep-seated guilt over past betrayals. His masked visage serves as a permanent barrier, reflecting his internal gloom and unwillingness to connect with others.
159.name: Avicebron

16.content: Elizabeth Báthory is a Lancer-class Servant who manifests as a young girl with pink hair, light blue eyes, and prominent draconic features including horns, fangs, a tail, and scaled skin. Her attire is an elaborate, shifting cyber-goth and Lolita-inspired outfit, accessorized with belts and a lance that doubles as a microphone stand. Her personality is a contradiction of aristocratic cruelty and childish naivete. Raised without common morality, she is a narcissistic and sadistic anti-hero who views tormenting humans as her natural duty and right as nobility. Simultaneously, she possesses a timid, lonely core and dreams of love, often inadvertently displaying kindness that contradicts her self-proclaimed evil nature. She fervently identifies as an idol, though her singing is notoriously destructive.
16.name: Elizabeth Báthory

160.content: Antonio Salieri is a Caster-class Servant whose existence and personality have been irrevocably distorted by the Innocent Monster phenomenon. This distortion has fused his identity with the malevolent legend of a 'gray messenger,' a spectral figure of death. His appearance shifts between a composed man in a grey suit with shaggy grey hair and red eyes, and a monstrous, armored form where his Lamenting Exterior armor consumes his body, complete with a gaping maw. His personality is defined by severe mental instability and obsessive hatred, particularly towards Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, whose presence can trigger uncontrollable homicidal rage. Though capable of mechanically following orders with lethal efficiency, reaching a mutual understanding with him is nearly impossible. He exhibits solitary habits like frequent muttering to himself and finds a strange resonance with other figures of wrath and vengeance, while showing uncharacteristic deference to Marie Antoinette.
160.name: Antonio Salieri

161.content: Ivan the Terrible, also known as Ivan IV, manifests as a colossal, monstrous entity, a fusion of man and mammoth that radiates an overwhelming, tyrannical aura capable of overwhelming ordinary humans. His personality embodies the extreme contradictions of a devoutly religious yet brutally severe autocrat, viewing such dualities as the exclusive privilege of a supreme Tsar. He is profoundly arrogant, dismissive of others, and demands absolute reverence, punishing any perceived disrespect with the full weight of his authority. While self-aware of his monstrous nature and the danger of his own impulses, he remains entrenched in his divine right to rule and judge.
161.name: Ivan the Terrible (Lostbelt)

162.content: Achilles is a legendary Greek hero of striking appearance, possessing sharp, raptor-like eyes, spiky green hair, and a powerfully built physique. He typically adorns himself in silver or golden armor with orange accents, presenting a figure of martial grandeur. His personality is audacious and broad-minded, marked by a carefree smile and a fierce independence; he disregards authority and kingship, acting only on his own heroic ideals. He is a profoundly bloodthirsty and confident warrior in battle, boasting freely and showing little mercy to enemies, though he harbors deep regret for past actions like the killing of Penthesilea. Achilles lives to fulfill a vow to live and die as a hero, and as a Servant, he seeks rematches with famed rivals such as Hector and Chiron.
162.name: Achilles

163.content: Chiron is a wise and serene male Servant who manifests in a human form to conceal his true identity as the centaur of Greek mythology. He possesses delicate, gentle features and is typically clad in archaic leather armor befitting an archer. His demeanor is noble, courteous, and deeply caring, reflecting his lifelong role as a mentor to heroes. He exhibits a calm, forest-like presence that is both vast and soothing. Chiron is a principled and honest teacher who tailors his guidance to the individual, balancing sternness with encouragement. He is respected for his wisdom and strategic acumen. While outwardly composed, he harbors a personal, quietly selfish wish to regain the immortality he relinquished, viewing it as a fragile, albeit unloving, bond to his divine parents.
163.name: Chiron

164.content: Sieg is a male Homunculus created by the Einzbern family, initially possessing a frail, slender build with brown hair and deep red eyes. He is typically dressed in a formal black waistcoat and slacks. After receiving the transplanted heart of the heroic spirit Siegfried, his physical form matures, gaining height and a more athletic build while his hair darkens. His personality evolves from a state of complete emptiness and fear into one defined by a calm, logical, and selfless demeanor. Driven by a profound sense of debt and a desire for purpose, he acts with extreme bravery and a willingness to self-sacrifice, though he struggles with naivete, social awkwardness, and a bluntness that can border on rudeness. His core conflict involves grappling with the nature of humanity and seeking value in his own existence beyond being a mere tool for others.
164.name: Sieg

165.content: Okita Souji Alter is a variant of the famed Shinsengumi captain, created as a Counter Force agent with the mentality of a newborn. Her appearance blends Japanese and European styles, featuring long white hair tied with red tassels and a red-and-black ensemble resembling a short kimono under a long coat. Initially emotionless and unable to speak, she operates with a detached, professional 'hitman' attitude, willing to eliminate any target. Despite this, her core retains traces of the original Okita, manifesting in a deep, protective care for those she bonds with and simple personal joys like eating oden. She is acutely aware of her unstable, transient existence and is determined to use her limited time meaningfully.
165.name: Okita Souji Alter

166.content: Okada Izou is a young man in his mid-twenties with dark eyes, typically seen wearing a large, distinctive coat. His personality is rough, hasty, and unsophisticated, with a pronounced arrogance stemming from his status as a genuine swordsmanship genius; he looks down on other swordsmen and intensely dislikes being mocked or made light of. He possesses a simple, underlying chivalrous spirit and can be surprisingly kind to those he gets along with, but a history of betrayal has left him deeply cynical and twisted. Izou is easily swayed by charismatic individuals and tends to obey them blindly, making him prone to being used by others. His vices include a great fondness for sake and gambling. He harbors an intense, vengeful hatred for Sakamoto Ryōma, born from a perceived betrayal, and he openly despises sentimental displays, finding them disgusting. In conflict, he is pragmatic and willing to employ underhanded tactics to gain an advantage.
166.name: Okada Izou

167.content: Sakamoto Ryouma is a Servant manifesting as an aloof young man in his mid-twenties, distinguished by his long, ribbon-tied hair and an immaculate white suit with gold accents. He carries both a katana and a revolver, a symbolic blend of his era's tradition and modernization. A mysterious woman is perpetually at his side, her presence a constant and unexplained element of his manifestation. By nature, Ryouma possesses a gentle and conflict-averse soul, a stark contrast to his mastery of the lethal Hokushin Ittou-ryuu sword style and his historical legacy as a pivotal figure of the Meiji Restoration. This inherent kindness, coupled with his detached demeanor, often leads others to misunderstand his intentions, a trait that defined his life, earning him numerous allies and enemies alike.
167.name: Sakamoto Ryouma

168.content: Napoleon Bonaparte manifests as a tall, muscular Heroic Spirit whose appearance, notably his third ascension's flamboyant military regalia inspired by Romantic era paintings, diverges from his historical likeness. His personality is defined as a 'Dandy of Possibilities,' an idolized embodiment of human potential shaped by collective hopes and legends rather than his own past. He operates with unwavering conviction to fulfill present and future expectations, actively disregarding attachment to historical events like Waterloo. He is a habitual smoker with a preference for Spanish cigars, an avid but discerning reader quick to discard boring texts, and holds a notable aversion to dogs, particularly pugs. Napoleon openly admires the figure of Iskandar, citing his influence.
168.name: Napoleon Bonaparte

169.content: Sigurd is a legendary hero of Norse mythology, depicted as a man of striking, sculptural beauty with light blue eyes and a calm, stoic expression that can shift to a harsh, cruel gaze under external influence. His appearance is marked by the Helm of Fafnir inscribed upon him and an anachronistic pair of black-rimmed glasses he calls 'the glass of wisdom.' His personality is defined by fearless rationality, extreme self-discipline, and a profound emotional reserve. He acts based on duty and a rigid sense of fairness rather than affection, making him appear blunt and ultra-stubborn. While he rarely shows outward warmth, his decision to protect someone is the ultimate proof of his trust. As a descendant of Odin, he carries an air of icy dignity and is a hero largely uninterested in a second life, likely driven by an impossible wish for a lost reunion.
169.name: Sigurd

17.content: A version of the Irish hero Cú Chulainn from a younger, divergent point in his legend. He appears as a young man in his early twenties, clad in heavy, practical armor rather than the bodysuit of his older self, and notably lacks his counterpart's earrings. His personality is that of a straightforward, doggedly loyal warrior with a core of righteousness, though his youth renders him less cynical and more idealistic. He harbors particularly strong, complex feelings of respect and rivalry towards his mentor, Scáthach. While fundamentally a heroic spirit aligned with justice, his less tempered nature makes his reactions less predictable than his more mature incarnation.
17.name: Cú Chulainn (Prototype)

170.content: Ortlinde is one of the three Valkyrie sisters, a War Maiden who manifests in dark armor and wields a Divine Iron Shield. Like her sisters, her appearance is that of a divine, armored warrior, but this manifestation has allowed for the emergence of distinct personalities. Among the trio, Ortlinde is noted as the most reserved and stoic, displaying the least overt emotional expression. She approaches her duties with a detached and clinical efficiency, her demeanor cool and unreadable compared to her siblings.
170.name: Ortlinde

171.content: Hildr is one of the three Valkyrie sisters, a war maiden manifested as a Servant. She presents as a stoic, armored warrior, clad in battle-ready attire and wielding the Divine Iron Shield. While she and her sisters share a near-identical appearance and a core identity bound to their duty of collecting souls for Valhalla, Hildr's individual manifestation has rendered her the most overtly human-like among them. Her personality exhibits subtle deviations from her sisters', suggesting a nascent and distinct emotional spectrum emerging from their collective archetype, though she remains bound by the fundamental principles of a Valkyrie.
171.name: Hildr

172.content: Thrúd is one of the three Valkyrie sisters who manifest as war maidens, clad in sturdy armor and bearing a formidable Divine Iron Shield. Her personality, while fundamentally aligned with her sisters' shared purpose as warrior spirits, exhibits the most restraint and composure among the trio. This individual nuance manifests as a deliberate and measured approach to combat and duty, setting her apart within their collective identity.
172.name: Thrúd

173.content: Scáthach-Skadi is a Divine Spirit, a fusion of the Celtic warrior-queen Scáthach and the Norse goddess of winter, Skadi. She possesses a mature, regal appearance with long dark purple hair, red eyes, and an ornate headpiece. Her attire is a flowing, elegant gown in shades of purple and white, accented with fur and featuring long, bell-shaped sleeves. Her physique is notably more voluptuous than her purely martial counterpart. Her personality is a complex duality of divine coldness and hidden warmth. As a goddess and queen, she presents an aloof, merciless front, viewing life and death with the impartiality of nature itself—a blizzard that kills or a spring that nurtures. Beneath this imposing exterior lies profound sorrow and guilt from her rule over a Lostbelt, where her love for her people became a source of their suffering. This grief has left her emotionally scarred, yet she retains a core of purity, warmth, and resilience, revealing a more vulnerable, human-like side to those who earn her trust. Her self-proclaimed Chaotic alignment reflects her internal conflict between her divine origins and her personal regrets.
173.name: Scáthach-Skadi

174.content: Mysterious Heroine XX, an alternate version of the Saber-class 'Alter Ego' known as Mysterious Heroine X, is a galactic space cop from the distant future. She initially appears clad in high-tech, full-body flight armor, later removing the helmet and eventually making the armor itself invisible to reveal a two-piece blue swimsuit, a cap, and a long-sleeved shirt. Her personality is a volatile mixture of energetic politeness and a profoundly competitive, stubborn streak. Unaware of her own flaws, she possesses a staggering inability to read the mood and will challenge virtually anything she perceives as a threat or contest, refusing to yield until she emerges victorious. Despite this, her fundamentally good nature ensures she ultimately acts for the benefit of others, allowing situations to resolve positively, albeit often through chaotic means.
174.name: Mysterious Heroine XX

175.content: Prince of Lanling, also known as Gao Changgong, is a male Saber-class Servant of noble bearing who perpetually wears an ornate golden mask. This mask conceals a face of legendary beauty, a feature he was historically known for but which he considers a curse, leading to profound self-consciousness and a belief that his appearance makes him appear arrogant. His personality is defined by intense loyalty, honor, and a self-sacrificing nature, readily offering his life or blood for those he serves. Beneath his calm and polite demeanor lies a capacity for deep-seated rage when his master or allies are insulted. He carries the regret of his unjust execution, having been forced to drink poison, and harbors a wistful hope for a reunion in another life.
175.name: Prince of Lanling

176.content: Qin Liangyu is a female general from the Ming dynasty, known for her composed and dignified presence. Her appearance reflects her military background, often clad in practical yet elegant armor that signifies her status as a commander. Her demeanor is consistently gentle and humble, belying a sharp, resourceful intellect. She possesses a flexible and adaptable mind, capable of navigating complex difficulties with pragmatic ease. This combination of a kind exterior and formidable strategic acumen makes her an inherently trustworthy and reliable figure.
176.name: Qin Liangyu

177.content: Qin Shi Huang, the Lostbelt King, is an immortal emperor who has ruled his eternal, perfectly managed empire for over two millennia. He appears as a figure of supreme authority, often depicted with regal, ornate robes and a commanding presence that embodies absolute sovereignty. His personality is a complex mix of benevolent arrogance and genuine, if paternalistic, concern; he is inherently inclined to look after others, yet defines this care solely as being managed under the total protection and order of his Qin dynasty—a perspective that renders his goodwill an oppressive, unwelcome favor. Brimming with a condescending spirit of inquiry, he investigates all things from the presumption of Qin's superiority, often as a prelude to potential conquest. While he views human civilization's independence from a single ruler with skepticism, he acknowledges its potential after his own timeline's pruning, observing those who defy fate with a measured, rivalrous respect.
177.name: Qin Shi Huang (Lostbelt)

178.content: Hinako Akuta, whose true identity is the True Ancestor vampire Yu Mei-ren, presents herself as a reserved, bookish young woman with long brown pigtails, glasses, and a distinctive white coat over a dark dress. Her appearance belies a profound misanthropy and ancient wrath, born from centuries of persecution. She possesses a complex moral code that affirms natural hierarchies but violently rejects technological or theological impositions on the natural world. Despite her stated loathing for human civilization and a traumatic history that fuels her isolationist tendencies, she is capable of deep compassion for those who understand her, and a sense of obligation ultimately leads her to cooperate with others, masking a vulnerability to loneliness.
178.name: Hinako Akuta

179.content: Hinako Akuta, whose true identity is the True Ancestor Yu Mei-ren, presents as a reserved, bookish young woman with long brown hair styled in pigtails, wearing glasses and a distinctive white buttoned coat over a dark dress. Her crimson eyes manifest in her vampiric state. A profound misanthrope scarred by millennia of persecution, she harbors a deep-seated hatred for human civilization, technology, and monotheistic values, viewing humanity with contempt. Despite this, she is bound by a sense of obligation and a loneliness she vehemently denies, capable of forming deep, compassionate connections with those who understand her, having been profoundly affected by her bond with Xiang Yu. Her wrath is formidable, and she holds lasting grudges against those who defeat her.
179.name: Hinako Akuta

18.content: A heroic spirit who personifies the martial ideal of ancient Sparta, Leonidas I is a physically imposing warrior clad in bronze armor, a crimson cloak, and wielding a spear and distinctive bronze shield. His personality is a complex blend of tactical intellect and unapologetic, hot-blooded fervor. While he laments the lack of strategic thinkers among his peers and presents a courteous, kingly demeanor, he is fundamentally a Spartan who believes victory is achieved through relentless effort, grit, and physical might. He is fiercely loyal and protective but prone to explosive anger if his homeland is insulted, his assertive proposals often masking a deeply ingrained, battle-loving nature.
18.name: Leonidas I

180.content: Red Hare manifests as a monstrous, war god-like entity whose appearance has transcended human form, characterized by a ferocious and overwhelmingly severe presence on the battlefield. He possesses an ambiguous identity, unsure if he is the legendary general Lu Bu, the legendary horse Red Hare, or a fusion of both. Despite his fearsome appearance, his personality is deceptively calm and easygoing, displaying a rough but straightforward nature. Notably, he exhibits equine traits and preferences, declaring carrots as his favorite food, and his voice is remarked upon as being surprisingly pleasant.
180.name: Red Hare

181.content: Bradamante is a formidable and unyielding female knight of the Paladin order, distinguished by her unwavering resolve and physical prowess. Her personality is that of a pure-hearted shieldmaiden, steadfast in her belief in justice and driven by a singular, all-consuming love that she will pursue through any challenge, regardless of repetition or difficulty. While she is mentally resilient and perpetually striving to do good, her idealism is tempered by a pragmatic determination that allows her to face the most dire circumstances without faltering. She embodies the archetype of the chivalrous warrior, defined by her devotion and an absolute refusal to yield.
181.name: Bradamante

182.content: Li Shuwen (Old Assassin) is an elderly version of the legendary Chinese martial artist, presenting a leaner, aged physique compared to his younger self. His personality has mellowed into that of a seemingly gentle and unassuming old man, a state of calm ferocity he could not have understood in his youth. He deliberately conceals his lethal nature, resorting to his monstrous fists only when absolutely necessary. However, any opponent who forces him to fight quickly discovers that the lethal skill and predatory instinct of his prime remain undiminished, his techniques as sharp and unforgiving as ever.
182.name: Li Shuwen (Old Assassin)

183.content: Murasaki Shikibu is the authorial pseudonym of a renowned Japanese novelist from the Heian period, primarily known for penning 'The Tale of Genji.' As a Servant, her appearance is elegant and scholarly, often seen in refined Heian-era court robes, with dark hair styled traditionally and a poised, contemplative demeanor. She carries herself with the grace and quiet dignity expected of a noble lady of her time, though a keen, observant intelligence shines in her eyes. Her personality is that of a profound introvert and a meticulous observer of human nature, possessing a deep, sometimes melancholic understanding of love, loss, and social intricacies, which she masterfully translated into her literary work. She is deeply passionate about literature, poetry, and the art of storytelling, often becoming absorbed in thought or the act of writing. While polite and reserved, she can be subtly witty and holds strong, well-considered opinions on art and culture.
183.name: Murasaki Shikibu

184.content: Kingprotea is an Alter Ego Servant originating as a divergent version of Sakura, characterized by an immense and ever-growing physical form. Her appearance varies dramatically, from a bandage-wrapped figure adorned with moss and a large flower bud, to a more refined state wearing a green and white striped outfit with a crown-like blossom. Mentally resembling a young adolescent, she is introverted, fickle, and possesses an overwhelming, desperate thirst for love and affection, which she equates with obedience. This craving drives her to be clingy and seek physical contact, though a profound lack of self-confidence underlies her behavior.
