Fundamentally, she is a sheltered being brimming with a love for all existence, yet unable to comprehend personal, human-scale love.
269.name: Kukulkan (Lostbelt)

27.content: Martha, the Saint of Bethany, is a figure whose external appearance of saintly grace and beauty—marked by her long purple hair, flowing white and red garments, and signature golden cross staff—belies a far more dynamic personality. While initially presenting as the archetypal gentle, kind, and reliable saint with a protective older-sister demeanor, she possesses a fiercely determined and occasionally sharp-tongued side that surfaces when provoked, a remnant of her more spirited life before sainthood. Despite these contrasting facets, her core remains that of a genuine saint, guided by an indomitable spirit, deep love for people, and unwavering faith.
27.name: Martha

270.content: Johanna presents as a paradox, being a fictional existence who carries the mantle of a pope. Her appearance, particularly in earlier depictions, features brown hair. Her personality is defined by a profound internal conflict, as she is both depressed and frustrated by the historical evidence disproving her existence, yet believes it was right to do so; this leads her to question her own legitimacy and right to pray. Despite this, she embodies an unexpectedly cheerful, spunky, and confrontational nature, which she channels into a 'might makes right' philosophy used to defend the weak. She values earnest prayer and virtuous living but is unapologetically easygoing and enjoys friendly physical brawls, which she frames as acts of spirited charity. This combination of deep doubt, fierce protectiveness, and unorthodox zeal positions her as a complex, if contradictory, exemplar of a righteous path.
270.name: Johanna

271.content: Takasugi Shinsaku is a Saber-class Servant whose appearance of a calm, intellectual man belies a wild and disruptive temperament. A free-spirited troublemaker, he operates as a self-described one-man-show, prioritizing personal amusement and acting independently of others, with a willingness to engage in any action he finds interesting, regardless of conventional morality or consequences.
271.name: Takasugi Shinsaku

272.content: Larva Tiamat manifests as a younger, petite iteration of her Beast-class form. Her appearance is defined by light blue hair, distinctive star-shaped pupils within pink eyes, and a pair of large horns she finds cumbersome. She wears a modest blouse with sleeves covering her hands. Her personality is complex, as she remains burdened by the grief and resentment stemming from her prior defeat in Mesopotamia. However, she has consciously resolved to suppress these darker emotions, actively choosing to prioritize the well-being and continuation of her children, the life forms of the world, over her own desire for vengeance or reclamation.
272.name: Larva Tiamat

273.content: Draco, the juvenile form of Beast VI/Sodom's Beast, manifests in several distinct forms. Her Heliocentric Form presents as a corrupted, younger Nero with draconic features, crimson eyes, wearing three crowns and minimal, striated clothing while carrying a tainted Holy Grail. Her more mature Geocentric Form adopts an adult appearance. As a being born from humanity's depravity, Draco paradoxically embodies a ruthless, tyrannical queen who despises corruption, sloth, futility, and unchecked passion, positioning herself as their inherent enemy. Governed by a strict, cold-hearted code, she enforces rules without breach. Beneath her contemptuous exterior and absolute refusal to show vulnerability lies a concealed, unacknowledged yearning for a virtuous human ideal. Her personality is defined by this ultimate, internalized tsundere conflict between her despotic nature and hidden aspirational desire.
273.name: Sodom's Beast/Draco

274.content: Locusta is a famous poisoner of ancient Rome, now manifested as an excessively high-strung and eccentric woman with a peculiar fixation on mushrooms. Her personality is generally fun and cheerful, marked by an intense, almost obsessive adoration for Emperor Nero and her supporters, contrasted by overblown and irrational distastes for others. Due to her profoundly unstable and volatile mindset, she is capable of offering lethal poison to others without any malicious intent, viewing it as a mundane or even friendly gesture. This lethal unpredictability, stemming from her loose grasp on conventional morality, defines her most dangerous and infamous trait.
274.name: Locusta

275.content: Sétanta is the younger form of the hero Cú Chulainn, manifested as a small-statured, feral boy. His appearance belies his serious training, as he possesses a lean, athletic build honed for combat. Personality-wise, he is fundamentally naive, bright, and impulsive, acting on instinct before thought. This wildness is tempered by rigorous education from his mentors, Fergus and Scáthach, instilling in him a disciplined, courteous side—especially towards superiors—though his free-spirited nature surfaces when unsupervised. Driven by an intense, personal ambition, his sole focus is achieving the goal of becoming the strongest hero through his own power, rendering the Holy Grail irrelevant to his purpose.
275.name: Sétanta

276.content: Kashin Koji is a sorcerer who gradually replaced their organic body with mechanical puppet parts, eroding their original identity. Their current form, the 'Last Model: Jorougumo,' presents as a woman, though they previously manifested as a male 'Midstage Model: Akushirou.' To define their increasingly unstable self, Kashin Koji adopts the behaviors and personalities projected onto them by others, such as acting as a deceased loved one if so perceived. Their current calm and reserved demeanor is a deliberate replication of a specific young woman, a Sengoku general's wife who died young, whose visage they permanently wear. The sole remnant of Kashin Koji's true essence is said to reside in their deep, melancholic scarlet gaze.
276.name: Kashin Koji

277.content: Bhima is a powerful warrior of immense physical stature, possessing a large, muscular frame and an imposing presence befitting his status as one of the legendary Pandava brothers. His personality is unexpectedly cheerful and straightforward, characterized by a simple, earnest honesty. He operates on a fundamental code of conduct, believing that a direct question demands a direct answer, even regarding his True Name as a Servant. This earnest nature extends to his belief that earnest discussions are best had alongside delicious food, showcasing a surprisingly approachable and gregarious side to the formidable hero.
277.name: Bhima

278.content: Duryodhana is a charismatic yet deeply flawed prince from the Indian epic, the Mahabharata. He possesses a compelling presence that makes him difficult to dislike, masking a personality prone to intense jealousy, greed, and hatred. Believing himself to be the destined protagonist of his own story, he rationalizes deceit and unethical actions as permissible for one in his role. Despite this, he is noted for a resilient spirit, prone to dramatic despair in failure but quick to recover, and is described as a paradoxical blend of cleverness and foolishness, immense pride and genuine charity. His appearance is that of a regal Kshatriya warrior, typically depicted with a powerful physique, adorned in royal armor and ornaments befitting his status as the eldest Kaurava prince.
278.name: Duryodhana

279.content: Durga manifests as a goddess of war and destruction, perpetually clad in an aura of serene, focused wrath. Her appearance reflects her martial nature, typically wielding multiple weapons. She operates with a polite but impersonal demeanor as a systemic force for eliminating evil, concealing any personal affection for mortals as a deliberate separation of her role from the more nurturing aspects of her divinity, such as Parvati. Her driving principle is the execution of her divine duty as a demon-slayer.
279.name: Durga

28.content: Medea is a Caster-class Servant, the legendary princess and sorceress from the tale of Jason and the Argonauts. Her appearance typically features a hooded, bluish-purple robe that conceals her face, revealing only her notably beautiful features and distinctive knife-shaped ears upon close inspection. When not engaged in conflict, she may adopt more casual attire, such as a black top with a jean jacket and long skirt. Her personality is a complex facade of cruelty and cold-heartedness, a role she adopted after a lifetime of betrayal and being cast as a convenient villain. Fundamentally, she is an innocent, compassionate, and devoted individual who yearns for a simple, happy life. This inner nature surfaces in her acts of morality, such as freeing captive children, and in her talents for detailed craftsmanship like model-making. Her deep-seated trauma and resentment manifest in a fierce dislike for being called a 'witch' and a merciless attitude towards those she perceives as having wronged her, particularly mature women and men reminiscent of Jason.
28.name: Medea

280.content: Medusa (Saber) manifests in a form distinctly younger than her Rider-class counterpart, possessing a notedly impressive physique. Her most infamous trait, the Mystic Eyes of Petrification, is typically sealed by a pair of glasses. This incarnation retains the traumatic memories of her transformation into a monster, forging a personality defined by profound bitterness and resentment. She harbors intense hatred towards the gods Poseidon and Athena for their role in her curse. Furthermore, she holds a deep-seated detestation for the concept of love itself, which she blames as the ultimate catalyst for her monstrous fate.
280.name: Medusa (Saber)

281.content: Aesc, a fairy born with the face of Artoria, exists in two key phases. As the sheltered Rain Witch of Orkney, she is a cheerful, idealistic, and tender-hearted scholar who dreams of building an ideal new Britain rather than destroying it. After her home's destruction, she manifests as the determined Savior, a figure of hope who journeys across Faerie Britain to aid the oppressed. This version rigorously suppresses her inner fury and hatred behind a facade of strict justice and gentle compassion, becoming unyieldingly righteous and fiercely intolerant of any betrayal. Her appearance evolves from simple black robes to a complex white witch's attire that synthesizes elements from her past and the Artoria lineage.
281.name: Aesc

282.content: Ptolemy is a Lancer-class Servant manifesting in his youthful form as a vibrant warrior. His appearance is that of a stylized Greek hoplite, with spiky white hair, light golden eyes, and ornate silver-and-gold armor. He is distinguished by his Corinthian helmet, adorned with an eagle crest and a red plume, a large shield bearing a black falcon, and a primary armament of a doru spear supplemented by two swords. Personality-wise, he presents as a lively and charismatic individual, capable of easy camaraderie. This affability, however, belies a complex and analytical mind; he possesses the strategic perspective of his older self, deeply evaluating actions from multiple angles. His loyalty is profound but conditional, rooted in his historical role during the Wars of the Diadochi. He will offer unwavering support to a cause he deems worthy, but is equally prepared to enact severe, merciless judgment against former allies should they betray his principles or the greater good.
282.name: Ptolemy

283.content: Theseus is a heroic figure from Greek myth, depicted as a young man of Ionian features with a tropical accent, dressed in an expensive, royally patterned Greek himation. His personality is characterized by a profound sense of duty, kindness, and a friendly demeanor. This is exemplified by his encounter with Asterios, whom he never regarded as a monster, instead perceiving a troubled human boy and forging a bond of mutual understanding before Asterios's death. Theseus exhibits a complex view of his royal obligations versus personal sentiment, claiming enduring love for Ariadne while pragmatically accepting her choice not to bear an heir and marrying another to secure his lineage.
283.name: Theseus

284.content: Takeda Shingen, the legendary Warring States daimyō known during his life as Harunobu, is a figure of imposing presence and supreme confidence. He appears as a powerfully built man with wild, light-colored hair, clad in ornate plate armor and a half-cloak, and wields a massive gunbai war fan as his weapon. A super-genius military commander blessed with both immense physical strength and intellectual brilliance, he is intensely serious and dedicated to his rule, viewing most others with disdain borne from a childhood where even his father seemed an idiot. His arrogance manifests in a combat style where he refuses to use both hands against an opponent unless they prove themselves worthy. This absolute self-assurance was fundamentally challenged only by his famed rival, Uesugi Kenshin.
284.name: Takeda Harunobu

285.content: Nagakura Shinpachi was a captain of the Shinsengumi, characterized by a bold and compassionate nature that endeared him to his subordinates but frequently brought him into conflict with authority. He maintained a staunch belief in his equality with Kondou Isami, refusing to be treated as a mere retainer. This internal conflict culminated during the group's retreat from Kyoto; unable to reconcile his principles with their new path, he chose to part ways with his comrades after the Battle of Kōshū. A lingering, profound regret over this decision continues to haunt him, as he perpetually questions whether he chose correctly when he abandoned the fellowship he helped build.
285.name: Nagakura Shinpachi

286.content: Uesugi Kenshin manifests as a Ruler-class Servant, an arbitrator maintaining neutrality through divine authority. Her appearance is defined by refined, traditional Japanese warrior's garb often adorned with snowflake and dragon motifs, signifying her historical title of the 'God of War.' Originally unable to comprehend human emotion in life, her current existence is defined by a profound paradox: her apotheosis into a divine, near-inhuman state has conversely granted her a rich spectrum of human sentiment. She now actively explores feelings of joy, sorrow, anger, and amusement with intense curiosity, often displaying a playful demeanor. This extends to learning new skills like English conversation, marking her ongoing journey to understand the humanity she was once detached from.
286.name: Uesugi Kenshin (Ruler)

287.content: Yamato Takeru is a Heroic Spirit of unspecified gender, presenting with an androgynous appearance that includes facial features and distinctive, bushy hair reminiscent of the Saber lineage. They are adorned in a traditional white tunic with black trousers, bracelets, a metal choker, and a beaded rosary. Personality-wise, Takeru is impulsive, self-assured, and initially dismissive of human fragility, possessing a history of lethal pragmatism born from exile following a familial tragedy. Despite this martial severity, they possess a preference for peaceful times and a simple appreciation for rice and miso soup, symbols of tranquility. They exhibit curiosity and confusion towards the unfamiliar Edo period, often struggling with contemporary concepts and idioms.
287.name: Yamato Takeru

288.content: Ushi Gozen (Avenger) is the manifestation of the legendary oni princess in the physical and mental state she possessed prior to meeting her son, Minamoto-no-Raikou. She appears as a young girl with demonic horns and wields a massive, flaming halberd, embodying her nature as a primordial divine calamity. Her previously dominant maternal instincts are vastly diminished, replaced by the cold, ruthless disposition of a 'motherless, murderous weapon.' Consumed by the grudge of her past defeat in the Waxing Moon Ritual, she embraces her role as a fiery demon of vengeance, though she consciously masks this dangerous nature within the public spaces of Chaldea. Her presence is monitored warily by several figures from her past, including Raikou and Kintoki, who are aware of her underlying volatility.
288.name: Ushi Gozen (Avenger)

289.content: Miyamoto Iori is a calm and stoic swordsman appearing as a Servant. His demeanor is collected and pragmatic, exhibiting a lawful neutral alignment as a Servant, a shift from his true neutral nature in life. This change correlates with a purposeful gap in his memories. Iori has consciously renounced both his wish from the Waxing Moon Ritual and the memories associated with it, believing his life's ambitions were already fulfilled. Unburdened by the past, he focuses entirely on the present as a Heroic Spirit, approaching his duties and conflicts with detached, tactical precision.
289.name: Miyamoto Iori

29.content: Gilles de Rais, a corrupted version of the once-noble Marshal of France, now manifests as a Caster-class Servant of extreme depravity. His appearance is tall and muscular, marked by a youthful but deathly pale face with unnervingly large, rolling eyes. He is adorned in a lavish, pitch-black cassock decorated with blood-red patterns, resembling a classic evil magician. His personality is defined by utter moral bankruptcy and a deep, obsessive madness. Initially seeking the Holy Grail to resurrect his lost love, Jeanne d'Arc, his mind has fractured, leading him to commit and revel in acts of horrific violence. He derives profound pleasure from the psychological torment of his victims, cultivating hope solely to amplify their despair at the moment of their gruesome deaths.
29.name: Gilles de Rais (Caster)

290.content: Andromeda is a princess of Aethiopia, possessing a strong-willed, tomboyish personality intertwined with a profound sense of royal duty and personal insecurity. Her appearance typically reflects her mythological origins as a sacrificial maiden, often depicted in attire suitable for her coastal homeland. Motivated by deep love for her people and parents, she voluntarily accepted her fate as a sacrifice to the sea monster Cetus. This act, born of duty rather than passivity, defines her complex character. While genuinely loving her savior and husband, Perseus, she harbors a persistent anguish over being perceived merely as a rescued victim rather than an equal hero. Her core desire is to transcend her role as the 'sacrificial maiden' and stand alongside Perseus as a fellow hero, seeking to understand his burdens and share his path, thereby redefining her own identity and worth.
290.name: Andromeda

291.content: Marie Antoinette Alter is an alternative, avenger-class incarnation of the former Queen of France. She manifests in the stark black mourning dress she wore to her own execution, a visual representation of her inner state. In direct contrast to her original self's acceptance, she is defined by a profound, all-consuming resentment and a vengeful desire to destroy the hopes and ideals she feels betrayed her. While she exhibits a strong, protective, and disciplinarian maternal instinct, particularly towards children and childlike spirits, this twisted form of motherhood is aimless and serves as a psychological shackle, deepening her torment.
291.name: Marie Antoinette Alter

292.content: Hassan of the Shining Star is an Assassin-class Servant identified by the signature skull mask and dark attire of his Order. His physical form is that of a dark-skinned, purple-haired youth with a toned physique and piercing amber eyes. Personality-wise, he is a fundamentally efficient and taciturn operative, coolly analytical of his own capabilities and prioritizing the swift elimination of magic-using threats due to his acknowledged spiritual weakness. Despite this detached, professional demeanor, he retains a latent, boyish sensitivity that subtly informs his actions.
292.name: Hassan of the Shining Star

293.content: Alessandro di Cagliostro, known as the Count of Cagliostro, is a Heroic Spirit who presents himself as a dignified gentleman. His appearance is marked by long grey hair, a short beard, and heterochromatic eyes—one green and one red—with a scar crossing the right. His attire is that of a refined noble, growing more ornate in detail. In personality, he is assessed by his peers as fiercely practical and well-suited for conflict, yet his excessively polite demeanor is perceived as disingenuous and slippery. Comparisons drawn by other Servants describe him as possessing an arrogant, vain, and sadistic nature beneath his civilized facade, with a vulgar and relentlessly predatory determination in pursuing his objectives.
293.name: Alessandro di Cagliostro

294.content: Aoko Aozaki is the Fifth Magician, a practitioner of the True Magic of the manipulation of time. In her youth, she appears as a beautiful, free-spirited, and somewhat clumsy teenager with long brown hair, blue eyes, and a preference for casual attire like sweatshirts and jeans. After using her Magic, her hair turns permanently red and her aging halts, presenting a more mature figure. Her personality is defined by an unyielding, authentic nature; she regrets nothing, acts on her own principles regardless of others' opinions, and despises self-deception. While aloof and capable of great destruction, she possesses a strong sense of justice and values all living things, often acting as a mentor to impart the 'value of life'. She harbors a profound, lifelong hostility toward her sister Touko. Despite her immense power, she strives to live as an honest person, rejecting the typical secrecy and ambition of mage society.
294.name: Aoko Aozaki

295.content: Soujuurou Shizuki is a seemingly average, scrawny teenager with grey eyes and dark, messy hair, often seen in his school uniform or a casual dark jacket. His unassuming appearance and quiet, stable demeanor mask a complex nature; he is considered harmless and devoid of malice, to the point of being functionally invisible to those who sense ill intent. However, this placid exterior can give way to cold, violent pragmatism when survival is at stake. Having been raised in isolation, he initially lacked a conventional human sense of self and morality, forcing him to consciously learn and adapt to societal norms. He views magecraft and modern technology with the same detached curiosity, perceiving no fundamental difference between them. Hidden bandages and a special collar conceal bite scars, hinting at a traumatic past. The author notes that his unassuming nature belies a potent, even predatory, physicality in intimate contexts.
295.name: Soujuurou Shizuki

296.content: Alice Kuonji is a young witch who does not physically age, maintaining a youthful appearance. She has pale skin, short black hair, and dark eyes, typically dressed in a long, elegant black dress with white accents. Her outward demeanor is purposefully cold, unexpressive, and misanthropic, projecting an aura of unapproachability as part of her witch persona. Beneath this icy facade, however, lies a complex personality: she is curious, short-tempered, and possesses a deeply possessive and pessimistic nature, born from a fear of loss and a desire to protect treasured memories. While she apathetically ignores most of the world, she reacts with swift and severe retribution against anyone who threatens her pride, her home, or her sense of ownership, displaying a ruthless pragmatism.
296.name: Alice Kuonji

297.content: Space Ereshkigal is the ascended, merged form of the underworld goddess from Pan Human History and the Servant Universe. She has fully accepted her transformation into a Beast-class entity, embracing it not as a malevolent force but as a new aspect of her being. Her appearance and demeanor reflect this evolution; she carries herself with a casual, elegant, and confident grace, her manner positive and free. While her speech patterns retain her signature phrase '~na no dawa,' she avoids negativity, openly expressing her honest feelings. She boldly proclaims her role as a 'super goddess' who will guide both humanity and Beasts, wielding Authority comparable to a vengeful deity. This self-acceptance and love for her own perceived flaws have culminated in her radiant, self-assured identity as Space Ereshkigal.
297.name: Space Ereshkigal

298.content: Ciel is an Executor of the Church with fair skin, blue hair styled in a pixie cut, and a notably curvaceous figure often remarked upon for its fullness. Her personality is outwardly cool, rational, and impartial, treating her duties with unwavering fortitude and earning her the moniker 'Iron Lady'. She operates with strategic logic and extraordinary perseverance, suppressing personal emotion to function as a focused instrument against evil. Beneath this disciplined exterior lies a playful and mischievous side, which manifests in a desire to tease and gain the attention of those she cares for, contrasting her otherwise duty-driven existence devoid of personal desires.
298.name: C.I.E.L

299.content: Mysterious Heroine XX Alter is a Foreigner-class Servant who presents a contrasting persona to her more heroic counterpart. Her appearance and demeanor are that of a weary, street-smart professional—an enigmatic, easygoing older woman with a pronounced sweet tooth, often found indulging in late-night snacks. Despite adopting the theatrical guise of a villain, her core behavior is defined by a paradoxical, knightly devotion to her duties and a magus-like formality towards those she serves, a trait reminiscent of her mentor, Agravain. She generally reacts with disinterest to the nickname 'Ecchan,' though she makes a notable exception for Mysterious Heroine X, whose existence and chosen title remain a pivotal, ominous focus for her ongoing personal conflict.
299.name: Mysterious Heroine XX Alter

3.content: Artoria Pendragon Alter, also known as Saber Alter or the Blackened King of Knights, is a corrupted aspect of the legendary king. Her physical appearance reflects this inner transformation: her skin is pale, her eyes have shifted from green to a luminous gold, and she is clad in a suit of heavy, jet-black armor. The corruption has inverted key aspects of her personality, resulting in a cold, ruthless, and tyrannical demeanor focused on achieving her ideals through sheer power and cruelty rather than benevolence. She displays a practical, unemotional approach to ruling and combat, viewing heroism as a duty to be hated. Despite this harsh exterior, the core of her identity and her fundamental goals remain unchanged. Notably, she exhibits a voracious appetite, now preferring simple, abundant junk food over refined cuisine.
3.name: Artoria Pendragon Alter (Saber)

30.content: Hans Christian Andersen manifests as a young boy in formal attire, his childlike form sharply contrasted by a weathered adult voice and a body marked with scales, burns, and frostbite—physical manifestations of the suffering from his tales. His personality is that of a profoundly cynical and pessimistic author, possessing high observational skills which he uses to deliver brutally honest, unflinching critiques of others' flaws and the inherent ugliness of the world. He claims to hate everything, yet operates with a methodical, writerly impartiality, driven by a core desire to provide a 'final light' or meaningful conclusion to stories of struggle and unrewarded lives. He holds no personal wishes, reflecting a lifetime of unmet desires.
30.name: Hans Christian Andersen

300.content: Hakuno Kishinami is a teenage boy with brown hair and eyes, typically attired in the standard male uniform of Tsukumihara Academy, consisting of a jacket worn over a black t-shirt. Personality-wise, he is extroverted, active, and possesses a genuine, if sometimes subconscious, fondness for people, which drives him to engage with and aid others despite his own fragile internal state. He holds ordinary moral convictions, strongly opposing undue violence and evil, and will stubbornly commit to helping those in trouble within his means to secure an acceptable resolution for them. While outwardly appearing as a kind and chill individual, internally he is delicate and sensitive. His speech is characteristically considerate, intellectual, and direct, often avoiding idle chatter in favor of concise, carefully considered statements.
300.name: Hakuno Kishinami (Male)

301.content: Hakuno Kishinami is a female student with long, wavy brown hair and eyes, presenting in the standard Tsukumihara Academy uniform complete with a black turtleneck and pantyhose beneath. Her personality is a study in contrasts: outwardly composed, detached, and curt, which can be misconstrued as indifference, yet inwardly she is hot-blooded, deeply compassionate, and gallant. She possesses a strong, independent sense of self, though one marked by a curious lack of a defined identity, which drives her profound interest in other people. Her thought process is analytical and deliberate, leading to decisive and bold action once a decision is made. Hakuno exhibits little social tact, is merciless in her pursuit of truth, and is notably perseverant. Her speech is collected, objective, and unemotional, reflecting a preference for listening over self-expression.
301.name: Hakuno Kishinami (Female)

302.content: Tutankhamun manifests as a Servant in the physical form of his nine-year-old self, the age at which he ascended to the throne. His personality starkly contrasts the typical image of an autocratic pharaoh; he is profoundly kind, devoted, and egalitarian, showing unwavering respect to all individuals regardless of their station. He is driven by a deep-seated desire to serve his people and the world with maximum efficiency, often exhausting his own resources to achieve this goal. This dedication leads him to proactively intervene in affairs, sometimes employing discreet, behind-the-scenes methods to resolve issues before they escalate into public crises.
302.name: Tutankhamun

303.content: Louhi, the Witch of the North from Finnish mythology, manifests as a Servant in the form of a young girl with striking green hair, a stark contrast to her mythological depiction as an old crone. She suspects this youthful appearance stems from the blended Spirit Origins of her daughters. Her personality is a complex duality: she possesses the calm, experienced wisdom of an elder, yet her Berserker nature and youthful vessel can trigger intense rage or despair. She exudes a powerful maternal aura and is fiercely affectionate towards those she claims. Deeply scarred by past events, she harbors a profound wariness and hatred for cunning old men, specifically Väinämöinen. Her ultimate ambition was to restore her homeland, Pohjola, by recovering the legendary artifact, the Sampo.
303.name: Louhi

304.content: Phantasmoon is a True Ancestor who appears as a cheerful, energetic, and extroverted young woman. Her appearance features a distinctive blue and white dress with a full skirt, golden-embellished high-heeled boots, and a crescent moon-shaped rod. While presenting a generally positive and innocent demeanor, her Lawful alignment and status as a True Ancestor grant her a foundation of dry rationality, vast knowledge, and a decisive, combative nature. She is highly talkative and curious, actively engaging with others to understand their perspectives. However, this often culminates in her acknowledging their views before firmly rejecting them on a personal, moral level, leading to her characteristic declaration of intent to fight.
304.name: Phantasmoon

305.content: Richard I, known as the Lionheart, is a Saber-class Servant appearing as a young man with golden-blond hair streaked with red, clad in white knight armor and a crimson mantle. He possesses an eccentric and famously cheerful demeanor, earning him the nickname 'Yes and No,' but is capable of swift, ruthless charisma when serious. He values momentary impulses and the present above all else, a philosophy tied to his manifestation as a knight. Richard displays a unique, often inscrutable perspective, showing no fear of betrayal due to past experience and expressing regret for his perceived failures as a king. He harbors a profound, near-obsessive reverence for King Arthur and the legends of Camelot, to the point his deepest desire is to vindicate Arthur's reign. Despite his royal title, he is secretly embarrassed by his historical inability to speak English. He is mischievous, impulsive, and shows little concern for concealing his supernatural nature.
305.name: Richard I

306.content: Biscione is a Servant who manifests as a timid and anxious young woman, physically embodying the traits of a snake or small dragon. Her personality is defined by a profound lack of confidence and a persistent, vague anxiety stemming from her perception of herself as a 'designated victim.' Despite this, she possesses a core of quiet inner strength that ultimately enables her to persevere. Her primary motivation is a desperate wish for a safe, secure, and stable life, a desire so strong it has translated into a stressful, job-seeking mentality. She views her summoning as a Servant as an opportunity for stable employment, marketing herself with immense trepidation and a fear of failure, which she believes would lead to her inevitable demise.
306.name: Biscione

307.content: Dante Alighieri is a Caster-class Servant whose appearance and mannerisms are heavily stylized after the aesthetic of his epic poem, the Divine Comedy, often incorporating visual motifs of hell, purgatory, and paradise. His personality is characterized by a calculated, performative caution; he frequently feigns ignorance or plays the fool as a deliberate persona, though he acknowledges this act itself may be a folly. He possesses a distinct, mysterious laugh used habitually to buy time for thought. Having completed his own legendary journey, he now adopts the role of a guide for others, offering support while emphasizing their autonomy. His wish upon the Holy Grail is a tempered desire to return to his homeland of Florence and to see peace in Italy, a nation whose unification he views as largely complete.
307.name: Dante Alighieri

308.content: Metatron Jeanne is a Divine Spirit Servant representing an aspect of the archangel Metatron manifested within the vessel of Jeanne d'Arc, appearing slightly younger and shorter than her standard counterpart with distinctive golden eyes. Her personality is unstable, shifting between three primary states: a serious, class president-like demeanor; a slothful and lazy disposition after casting off that sin; and a transcendent, arrogantly perfect state that most fully reflects the archangel's authority. She is defined by the internal conflict between her human host's nature and the overwhelming divine power she embodies.
308.name: Metatron Jeanne

309.content: Ashoka is an ancient Indian emperor and a Chakravartin, a universal monarch. His appearance is regal and solemn, befitting a king, though details are often depicted with minimal ornamentation to reflect his later spiritual focus. Initially known as a ruthless conqueror, his personality underwent a profound transformation after witnessing the horrors of war. He became a devout follower of the Dharma, forswearing violence and dedicating his reign to governance through principles of peace, non-violence, and compassionate welfare for his subjects. As a Heroic Spirit, he views his existence as a service ordained by a higher, Dharmic purpose, and he approaches his duties with the serene and resolute dedication of a saintly king.
309.name: Ashoka

31.content: A legendary English playwright of the Elizabethan era, William Shakespeare manifests in refined, anachronistic Medieval clothing. His gentlemanly demeanor belies a personality wholly dedicated to the concept of the 'Story'. He operates as a detached authorial observer, manipulating events through deception and provocation to craft a compelling narrative. He displays profound, often exaggerated, interest in individuals he deems 'protagonists' while being dismissive of ordinary people. His speech is laced with self-quotations from his plays and modern fictional terminology, reflecting his narcissism and obsession with his literary legacy.
31.name: William Shakespeare

310.content: Lilith manifests initially as a sharp-eyed, calculating teenager, shifting to a more mature adult form in her final stage. Her personality presents a coldly pragmatic and hedonistic exterior, which masks a keenly observant and manipulative tactical mind suited for fieldwork. Fundamentally an anti-hero, she harbors a deep-seated, private contempt for humanity on an individual level, though she acknowledges a grudging, abstract appreciation for the species as a whole. A core aspect of her nature is a solemn, self-imposed duty to meticulously remember the life and emotions of every infant she has killed, carrying their memories as a burdensome record.
310.name: Lilith

311.content: Galahad is a Heroic Spirit and a Knight of the Round Table, renowned as the purest and most virtuous knight who achieved the Holy Grail. In appearance, he is a young man with gray hair, styled with bangs covering the left side of his face, pale golden eyes, and clad in ornate silvery-white armor. His personality is defined by an inhuman, detached, and absolute sense of fairness, described by his peers as calm, selfless to the point of disinterest, and lacking in personal desires or a clear wish. This purity manifests as a rigid and sometimes heartless adherence to his principles of chivalry and justice, leading him to reject summons he deems unjust. However, he demonstrates a deep, protective care for specific individuals, taking drastic actions to safeguard them from harm, even at great personal cost. His legacy is that of a flawless, yet ultimately distant, paragon.
311.name: Galahad

312.content: Typhon Ephemeros is the physical manifestation of the destructive Greek mythological monster, taking the form of a young girl with long red hair and heterochromatic eyes—one yellow, one pure black. Initially appearing with half-formed armor partially covered by the Chaos Tide, her true power reveals immense black-feathered wings, a full black dress and bonnet, and long magenta claws. Her personality is defined by profound malice and hatred, a stark contrast to the conceptual purity of Typhon. She harbors a specific, intense loathing for the Greek primordial deity Chaos, resentful that the corrupting substance she commands bears his name.
312.name: Typhon Ephemeros

313.content: Indra is a principal deity within the Vedic pantheon, renowned as a heroic god of thunder, war, and weather. While fundamentally male, his nature as an ancient divine being transcends conventional gender distinctions. His personality is a complex mix of cunning and honor; he is notably remembered for the cunning ruse he employed to acquire Karna's divine armor, yet he was equally moved by Karna's nobility to gift him the powerful spear Vasavi Shakti in return. He embodies a distinctly human-like temperament among gods, prone to jealousy, anger, and fear. This human touch often leads to an underlying sense of awkwardness in his interactions, particularly with figures like Arjuna, reflecting his history as both a warlike hero and a fallible being.
313.name: Indra

314.content: U-Olga Marie is an entity of the Alien God faction who forcibly adopted the form and memories of the deceased Chaldea director, Olga Marie Animusphere. Her appearance is dominated by floating regalia, including a fur-trimmed cloak, ribbons, a large crown, and distinctive metallic horns that orbit her head alongside a small golden horn on her forehead. Her personality is a volatile blend of haughty, imposing authority and a deeply buried, flustered sociability. She proclaims herself the 'President of Earth,' viewing humanity as inferior beings requiring her supervision and protection. This ostensible contempt masks a genuine, if awkward, desire for connection and a fierce, honor-bound respect for worthy opponents, traits that conflict with her programmed purpose as an Alien God. In battle, she sheds restraint, becoming passionately ruthless toward enemies while demonstrating unexpected generosity to allies.
314.name: U-Olga Marie

315.content: Jeunesse Crane is a younger alternate version of the benevolent Miss Crane, now adapted for summer activities. Her appearance shifts between a functional swimsuit, a stylish 'summer agent' outfit, and a school uniform. In personality, she retains a core of loyalty and devotion but expresses it with the energetic impulsiveness of youth. Her primary adolescent drive is a desire to be perceived as 'cool,' a goal often undermined by her transparent, emotionally expressive reactions. She actively champions the concept of youth, openly supports others in matters of romance, and maintains a facade of disinterest in idols that quickly crumbles into flustered, secret fascination.
315.name: Jeunesse Crane

316.content: Noah is a young man of sincere and amiable disposition, masking a mental age of centuries. He typically presents in an elegant, open blue robe adorned with gold jewelry, including a necklace bearing the Zohar gem, with the Sefirot pattern displayed on his back. Despite his divine mission and survivor's guilt over the Flood's victims, he maintains a friendly, self-deprecating nature, describing himself as a mere farmer chosen by God. He possesses a notable weakness for alcohol and a penchant for casual nudity, with an unconsciously erotic sleeping posture. A compulsive need for items to be in pairs defines his eccentricities, and he demonstrates a deep affinity for animals, though they frequently attack him. He harbors great admiration for Captain Nemo.
316.name: Noah

317.content: The Kawakami Gensai of Proper Human History was a petite and fair-skinned female swordsman whose delicate appearance could initially belie her nature. Her personality is characterized by a peculiar detachment and a single-minded, intense stubbornness that binds her to her own convictions, for better or worse. This manifests as polite gentleness in peacetime and a sudden, unflinching capacity for lethal violence that earned her the moniker "Pit Viper Gensai." She is capable of profound loyalty, though the reasoning behind her allegiances can often seem trivial or idiosyncratic, a trait that has led to personal regrets regarding her inflexible choices in life.
317.name: Kawakami Gensai

318.content: Elizabeth of the End is a markedly different iteration of the figure, appearing as a reserved priestess operating from the shadows of the planet Pumrs. Her demeanor is characterized by a detached, fundamentally serious outlook and a passive, aloof nature. Driven primarily by a sense of obligatory duty rather than personal desire, she approaches all tasks with a solemn weight. Notably concerned with maintaining her parental dignity, this version has wholly shed her usual flamboyant personality in favor of a somber dedication to her unseen responsibilities.
318.name: Elizabeth of the End

319.content: Lord Logres is an alternate manifestation of the King of Knights, presenting as a regal, armor-clad swordswoman. Her appearance evolves from gold-and-red armored plate akin to Artoria Pendragon, through a pure white gown, culminating in a more ornate and martial version of the legendary king's own armor. Her personality is that of a perfected ruler: calm, just, and introspective, devoid of personal ambition. She respects the pursuit of ideals in others but does not deify the ideals themselves. While implacably composed in peace, she openly expresses her martial passion as a 'King of War' in battle.
319.name: Lord Logres

32.content: Mephistopheles is a Caster-class Servant whose appearance is shaped by the Innocent Monster skill, presenting a demonic clown aesthetic. His attire is a flamboyant patchwork of purples, blues, and carmine, featuring a horned hat, a fur-trimmed cape, and high-heeled boots. He wields ornate, ever-changing shears as his primary weapon. Personality-wise, he projects a cheerful, easygoing facade but is fundamentally cruel and capricious. He views all relationships, including that with a summoner, as a source of amusement and may willingly engineer their despair for his own entertainment. Only through absolute, magus-like authority or complete acceptance of his wicked nature can his loyalty be tenuously secured.
32.name: Mephistopheles

320.content: Hebi Nyobo is a Servant whose appearance and demeanor are inextricably linked to themes of serpentine transformation and maternal sacrifice. Her visual presentation evolves across her forms, beginning with a stylish, fur-lined coat and culminating in a state where her eyes are closed, her limbs are covered in white scales, and she forgoes conventional attire, embodying her hybrid nature. This final form is a direct result of her lore, where she willingly sacrificed her own eyes for her child. Her personality is characterized by a serene, almost detached elegance, often speaking in a calm and measured tone. Beneath this placid exterior lies a profound, all-consuming love and protective instinct, which manifests as a willingness to commit any act, no matter how ruthless or extreme, for the sake of her offspring. This duality makes her both a figure of tragic beauty and unsettling, single-minded devotion.
320.name: Hebi Nyobo

33.content: A divine genius and a problematic individual, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is a Caster-class Servant whose existence is defined solely by his transcendent musical ability. He possesses an inhuman personality, acting entirely on his own whims with little regard for the feelings of others, a trait that has earned him a devilish reputation. While he enjoys conversation and jokes—particularly vulgar ones he struggles to suppress—his humor is often arcane and music-related. His entire being, including his wish upon the Holy Grail, remains devoted to one woman, Marie Antoinette, for whom he desires eternal happiness and the chance to perform his greatest work.
33.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart

34.content: A Pseudo-Servant of the ancient Chinese strategist Zhuge Liang, manifested primarily through the body and personality of the modern mage Lord El-Melloi II (Waver Velvet). He appears as a weary, bespectacled man in a formal suit, perpetually burdened by responsibility and cigarette smoke. His personality is defined by a cold, monstrous rationalism inherited from the Heroic Spirit, clashing with his host's more human cynicism, stress, and hidden sentimentality. He is a brilliant but chronically overworked tactician who masks his care for others behind sharp criticism and a seemingly exclusive interest in research, paperwork, and cafeteria sandwiches.
34.name: Zhuge Liang (Lord El-Melloi II)

35.content: Cú Chulainn (Caster) is a heroic spirit from Irish mythology manifested in the Caster class. His physical form is that of a lean, tall young man with spiky blue hair, often dressed in a dark bodysuit with light armor accents and wielding a large wooden staff, deliberately eschewing the metallic armor of his Lancer incarnation. His personality is that of a pragmatic and world-weary mentor, adopting the role of a guide and druid for the duration of his current contract. He possesses a sharp, cynical wit and a fatalistic outlook, often masking a deeply caring and protective nature behind a facade of casual indifference. As a Pseudo-Servant also housing the essence of the god Odin, Cú Chulainn's consciousness remains the dominant persona, granting him enhanced mystical knowledge and power while retaining his core identity.
35.name: Cú Chulainn (Caster)

36.content: Sasaki Kojirou is a wraith who manifests as a composed samurai swordsman with long indigo hair and eyes, clad in traditional light purple hakama and haori. He carries the sword Monohoshi Zao. His personality is aloof, elegant, and possesses a mocking wit, yet he adheres strictly to a personal code of bushido, valuing honorable combat above all else. He seeks only to test his skills against worthy opponents, displaying a detached, almost cold perspective on life and death. He acts with straightforward honor, disdaining underhanded tactics and showing no interest in personal gain or legacy.
36.name: Sasaki Kojirou

37.content: Hassan of the Cursed Arm is a legendary assassin and one of the nineteen leaders of the Hashshashin who inherited the name 'Old Man of the Mountain'. His physical form is unnaturally tall and gaunt, with a skeletal face devoid of skin and nose, presenting a visage of death. His most defining feature is his right arm, a bandaged, mummified limb described as a 'flat board' that houses his ultimate technique, the Zabaniya: Delusional Heartbeat. In stark contrast to his horrific appearance, his personality is characterized by a quiet, solemn loyalty and a deep, often mournful sense of purpose. He is profoundly devoted to the ideals of his order and possesses a complex sense of honor, shown through his protectiveness towards the innocent, particularly children, which stems from memories of his past life and lost love. His wish for historical renown was ultimately forsaken in his pursuit of the title, leaving him as a faceless guardian of a dark legacy.
37.name: Hassan of the Cursed Arm

38.content: Stheno is one of the three Gorgon sisters of Greek myth, a deity-like being manifested as a petite, pale-skinned figure with a refined Gothic Lolita aesthetic. Her surface personality presents an image of the 'ideal woman': elegant, graceful, and possessing a captivating, honeyed voice said to enthrall men. However, this is a facade for a deeply cruel and apathetic nature. She views humans, particularly men, not as equals but as playthings to be lovingly tormented and driven to ruin for her amusement. Lazy and profoundly cold-hearted, she shares an inseparable, almost symbiotic bond with her identical sister Euryale, with whom she often speaks as a single entity. Despite her apparent affection, her love is possessive and conditional, rooted in a history of resentment towards the fate she and her sisters endured.
38.name: Stheno

39.content: Jing Ke is a female assassin famously known for her failed attempt to assassinate the First Emperor of Qin, a historical act that contradicts her actual gender as presented in this iteration. Slender with sharp teal eyes, she wears her black hair in a long side ponytail and is clad in a multi-layered kimono with wide, floral-patterned trimmings, a blue and white sash, and large sleeves. Her personality is a complex blend of hedonism and lethal purpose; she is an avid reader, enjoys swordsmanship and intellectual conversation, but is most famously devoted to alcohol, often drinking to excess. This indulgence stands in stark contrast to her solemn duty as a wielder of the dagger 'Only For Killing,' reflecting a character defined by the tension between a desire for pleasure and the grim reality of her vocation.
39.name: Jing Ke

4.content: Artoria Pendragon Lily, colloquially known as Saber Lily or White Saber, is a youthful and idealistic iteration of the King of Knights. Her appearance is defined by pristine white and silver armor with blue accents, long blonde hair tied in a high ponytail, and bright, hopeful eyes. Her personality is that of an earnest, somewhat naive girl-knight, still in training and filled with romantic dreams of kingship. Unlike her later selves, she retains a pronounced girlishness and finds joy in simple pleasures, such as caring for horses, even amidst her rigorous and often harsh royal education. This version embodies a pure, untainted aspiration before the burdens of rule and fate solidify.
4.name: Artoria Pendragon Lily

40.content: Charles-Henri Sanson is a mild-mannered youth and devout believer who served as the royal executioner of Paris. He presents a stoic and neutral demeanor, often appearing as a reserved young man burdened by the gravity of his life's work. His philosophy is defined by a profound love for humanity as an abstract ideal, juxtaposed with a dutiful hatred for 'evil' as a concept, rather than the individuals who commit it. This leads him to embrace the paradox of using 'evil'—the act of execution—to cut down 'evil' itself. He operates with extreme strictness regarding the law, and his professional conduct is guided by a rigid, almost sacred, adherence to legal procedure. His faith in God is sincere, yet tempered by a pragmatic understanding of divine inaction, which further solidifies his resolve to carry out his grim duty as a necessary, sorrowful burden for the sake of societal order.
40.name: Charles-Henri Sanson

41.content: Phantom of the Opera, a wraith-like Servant, is a man eternally bound by the legacy of a famous novel. He hides his monstrous, distorted face behind a pale skull-like mask. His gentlemanly demeanor is a thin performance, a fragile mask over profound sorrow and homicidal rage that he constantly restrains through song. Should his singing cease, his monstrous nature emerges: a cold, methodical killer obsessed with cultivating a 'diva' with a beautiful voice, to whom he becomes perilously fixated. His grotesque form, with clawed hands concealed by black gloves, is a testament to the Innocent Monster skill that warped him.
41.name: Phantom of the Opera

42.content: Mata Hari is a Servant presenting as a woman in her late teens with an exotic appearance, characterized by sun-kissed skin, brown hair, and blue eyes. She is most notable for wearing a stylized, revealing yellow bedlah adorned with golden coins, hoop earrings, and floral hair accessories, which emphasizes her association with seductive dance. Her personality is overtly cheerful and maternally condescending, often treating men as children while masking a profound melancholy stemming from her tragic past as a courtesan and executed spy. She holds a strong admiration for nobility but harbors a deep-seated disdain for those who abuse political power, a reflection of her own exploitation. Despite her outwardly inviting demeanor, she is acutely aware of her own weakness as a Heroic Spirit and has resigned herself to the unattainability of her desires, such as a loving partnership or eternal youth.
42.name: Mata Hari

43.content: Carmilla is the mature, vampire-themed incarnation of the historical noblewoman Elizabeth Báthory, who fully embodies the legend of a blood-countess. She possesses a striking, voluptuous figure with eyes that can shift in color between depictions. Her personality is defined by haughty arrogance, deep-seated vanity, and a profound contempt for humanity forged by centuries of existence. Beneath this corrosive exterior lies a core of latent, twisted goodness and a lingering fear of the ignorance represented by her younger self, Elizabeth. She is a remorseless killer who views her victims as a means to an end, yet she displays a pragmatic capacity for cooperation if met with absolute understanding of her nature.
43.name: Carmilla

44.content: Heracles, summoned as a Berserker, is a colossal black giant whose monstrous physique and overwhelming presence inspire immediate terror. The Mad Enhancement inherent to his class has stripped away his capacity for conscious thought and most emotions, reducing him to a primal force of destruction driven by a core, unshakeable will. He retains a powerful instinct to protect his Master, Illyasviel von Einzbern, and exhibits a savage enjoyment of combat. His legendary history of berserker rages makes the class a familiar state for him. If summoned without Mad Enhancement, he would appear more human in expression while retaining his immense stature.
44.name: Heracles

45.content: Lancelot, known as the Berserker of Black, is a Heroic Spirit permanently altered by the curse of Mad Enhancement. His once-handsome visage is now a gaunt, pallid mask of hatred, his body encased in formidable, scratched black armor that obscures his identity. His personality is dominated by a raging, incoherent bloodlust and an all-consuming hatred, particularly directed towards his former king, Artoria Pendragon. This fury stems from a profound, twisted love and an insurmountable guilt over his past betrayals, which drove him to seek his king's ruin as a form of perverse atonement. He operates with lethal, instinctual skill in combat, a ghost of the peerless knight he once was.
45.name: Lancelot (Berserker)

46.content: A Berserker-class Servant summoned as Lü Bu, the legendary Chinese general infamous for his treachery. His appearance is that of a towering, powerfully-built man with short red hair, blank white eyes, and red feathers adorning his head. He is clad in heavy red and blue armor with thick, striped fur trimming, resembling a living fortress. Afflicted by a potent Mad Enhancement, he has lost all reason, rendering him an emotionless and insane combatant who communicates only through bestial roars. Historical records and sparse moments of clarity, such as a fleeting smile, suggest a deeply treacherous and battle-obsessed nature lies buried beneath the madness, making him an unpredictable and dangerous force.
46.name: Lü Bu

47.content: Spartacus is a giant of a man, standing over two meters tall, whose entire physique is defined by dense, scar-riddled muscle bound by leather straps. His pale skin is a canvas of countless wounds, and he perpetually wears a composed, unnerving smile, even in combat. As a Berserker, his personality is singularly fixated on rebellion against any perceived oppressor and the protection of the oppressed. He interprets all interactions through this lens, leading to a fundamentally unmanageable and unpredictable nature. Spartacus is entranced by suffering and battle, fighting with ecstatic glee. His logic, while internally consistent to him, rejects strategy and external command, making mutual understanding impossible. He seeks no Holy Grail, only the eternal battlefield where he can enact his endless revolt.
47.name: Spartacus

48.content: Sakata Kintoki is a Berserker-class Servant who embodies a boisterous, childlike energy despite his imposing, muscular frame. His personality is characterized by a straightforward, wild, and loud manner, marked by a strong sense of justice and a particular kindness towards children. He possesses a simple, almost elementary school mentality and an enthusiastic, all-consuming love for anything gold or flashy, frequently punctuating his speech with the word. His modern appearance features spiky golden hair, sunglasses, and an open white shirt adorned with excessive golden accessories, including belts, rings, and necklaces spelling 'GOLD'. He is often seen smoking. An alternate costume reflects his historical origins as a Heian-period warrior, featuring traditional Japanese armor and weapons, and revealing his blue eyes.
48.name: Sakata Kintoki

49.content: Vlad III's Berserker incarnation represents a catastrophic embrace of his vampiric legacy. Unlike his Lancer self who rejected the Dracula mythos, this form fully wields its powers as an indiscriminate force of destruction. Visually, he has shed all regal refinement, appearing as a monstrous entity consumed by his legend. Despite possessing coherent speech through a high rank of Mad Enhancement, his personality is defined by a predatory and merciless nature; he views cooperation with a summoner as a temporary, transactional alliance between a king and a servant, underpinned by the constant threat of him draining their blood. He deeply resents this state's existence but utilizes its horrors without restraint.
49.name: Vlad III (Berserker)

5.content: Nero Claudius is a Saber-class Servant, the historical Roman Emperor recorded as female. She presents with a flamboyant and confident demeanor, often described as haughty and self-assured. Her appearance is distinctive, featuring blonde hair styled in an intricate bun, bright green eyes, and a revealing red and white dress complemented by golden armored boots. Nero possesses a passionate and artistic soul, declaring a love for all forms of beauty and performance, which she considers synonymous with her rule. Her personality is characterized by immense pride, a theatrical nature, and a relentless pursuit of what she deems 'perfect.' This extends to a deeply held, if self-centered, concept of love and a refusal to acknowledge personal shortcomings. She exhibits a complex gender identity, describing herself as neither strictly masculine nor feminine.
5.name: Nero Claudius

50.content: Asterios is a Berserker-class Servant manifesting as a towering, muscular figure just under three meters tall, his body heavily scarred. His appearance blends human and bovine traits, featuring a wild white mane, thick horns that change in appearance, and animalistic eyes. He typically wears iron armor, restraints, and wields massive axes named Labrys. Despite his class, Asterios exhibits a surprisingly docile and childlike intelligence, capable of understanding ethics and common sense. He carries deep guilt over his monstrous nature as the Minotaur, yearning for recognition as a person rather than a beast, which fundamentally shapes his loyal and gentle disposition.
50.name: Asterios

51.content: Caligula, the Roman Emperor who succumbed to divine-induced madness, is a Berserker whose violent and sadistic impulses dominate his being. His physical appearance, though not detailed here, typically reflects a powerful, imposing frame marked by the torment of his condition. His personality is defined by an uncontrollable drive to inflict atrocities, a direct result of the Mad Enhancement that stripped him of all self-restraint. Despite this, a deep-seated affection for Rome and his niece Nero persists within his madness, occasionally serving as a potential anchor. The core of his tragedy is his desperate, suppressed wish to be free of the insanity inflicted upon him by the lunar goddess Artemis, a longing for the time he was remembered as a wise and benevolent ruler. In rare moments of clarity, such as when confronted by Artemis's power, his true, eloquent and regal nature is momentarily revealed.
51.name: Caligula

52.content: Darius III is a Berserker-class Servant who appears as a physically imposing figure, standing over three meters tall, which historically allowed him to tower over Alexander the Great. His default expression is one of calm resolve, though this masks an intense and indomitable fighting spirit that manifests as a destructive storm in battle. His personality is defined by an unwavering and silent demeanor, his human nature largely scattered by a high rank of Mad Enhancement, though he typically remains obedient to commands. His singular wish is for a military rematch against Iskandar, a desire potent enough to potentially override his usual composure.
52.name: Darius III

53.content: Kiyohime is a feminine Servant characterized by her long, pale mint-green hair styled with prominent bangs and side-tails, and decorative white horns with gold ornamentation. She is typically attired in a dark teal kimono with a black obi, accessorized with a red fan. Her appearance undergoes notable changes in alternate forms, shifting to lighter or darker color palettes, with her hair even changing to light pink. Her personality is defined by an obsessive, all-consuming love, stemming from her legend as the woman who transformed into a dragon. This manifests as extreme possessiveness, jealousy towards perceived rivals, and a violent intolerance for deception. While capable of displaying domestic affection and skill, her underlying nature is perilously single-minded and volatile.
53.name: Kiyohime

54.content: Eric Bloodaxe, a Berserker-class Servant, is a physically imposing Norse warrior permanently afflicted with high-rank Mad Enhancement. His appearance is that of a heavily armored, brutish figure, but his defining trait is the parasitic presence of his wife, Queen Gunnhild. Her spirit perpetually possesses his body, speaking through him with jealous fury and viewing his summoning as an insult. While Eric's own personality is almost entirely submerged, reduced to beast-like aggression and fragmented speech ("Gr, grrr"), rare moments of lucidity reveal a pragmatic, surprisingly rational warrior trapped within. He acknowledges his wife's control and the curse of his class, but remains a straightforward combatant dedicated to his Master's cause, however violently expressed.
54.name: Eric Bloodaxe

55.content: Tamamo Cat is a Berserker-class Servant who manifests as a physically powerful variant of Tamamo-no-Mae, possessing a more muscular build and bestial features such as feline paws in place of hands and feet. Her personality is a blend of pure sincerity and feral instinct, behaving like an unpredictable wild creature whose primary drives are seeking pleasure, tasty food, and engaging in 'hunting' according to her whims. Despite her classification and erratic, often nonsensical speech patterns, she exhibits unwavering loyalty to those she acknowledges as her lord, transforming into a devoted guardian. She retains domestic skills from her origin, particularly enjoying cooking and café management.
55.name: Tamamo Cat

56.content: Ruler-class Servant Jeanne d'Arc is a heroic spirit manifested through a near-total fusion with her mortal vessel, a French girl named Laeticia. Her appearance is that of a young woman with long blonde hair typically worn in a thick braid and amethyst-colored eyes, bearing a striking but serene beauty. In a combat state, she dons energy-woven armor. Her personality is a composite of the saint's profound, rule-bound faith and the host's more mundane traits, resulting in a fundamentally kind but reserved and occasionally socially awkward individual. She is wholly dedicated to maintaining order and possesses no personal regrets or desires for the Holy Grail, finding purpose in prayer and duty. The merged consciousness grants her knowledge and abilities, such as literacy, that the historical Jeanne lacked.
56.name: Jeanne d'Arc (Ruler)

57.content: Orion, known in this manifestation as a small brown bear adorned with primitive attire and wielding a club, is an anomalous entity defying clear classification as either human or beast, often appearing as a mascot-like creature. This form is inhabited by the consciousness of the Great Hunter Orion, while the goddess Artemis primarily governs their shared existence. Artemis maintains a detached, superior demeanor befitting her divine status, viewing others from a position of inherent authority. Orion's personality within this vessel is markedly subservient and sycophantic, focused on mediating interactions and ingratiating himself to others due to his perceived lack of independent power, often to placate Artemis's condescension.
57.name: Orion (Artemis)

58.content: A cheerful, sharp-tongued fox-eared Caster manifesting as a devoted partner figure. She presents as a bubbly, modern 'Gal-type' but masks deep-seated loneliness and a cynical, pragmatic worldview. Her true nature is that of an ancient, powerful fox spirit (Huli jing/Kitsune) capable of shapeshifting, though trauma makes her reluctant to use this ability. She is intensely loyal and romantically devoted to her chosen partner, prioritizing their happiness above all else. While often playful and affectionate, she possesses a caustic wit, a jealous streak, and a vicious temper when provoked or when her loved one is threatened. Her character is a complex blend of light-hearted comic relief and the darker, misunderstood nature of a legendary seductress and divine beast.
58.name: Tamamo-no-Mae

59.content: David is a legendary king of Israel, originally a shepherd and harpist before ascending to the throne. His appearance is that of a handsome, charismatic young man often depicted with a harp and simple regal attire. Personality-wise, he is a complex blend of devout piety and pragmatic realism. A self-proclaimed messenger of God, he approaches all situations with a calm, strategic mind, viewing people as part of a divine plan to be respected. He is shrewd in matters of finance and governance. However, this noble front is undercut by a profound and openly admitted weakness for beautiful women, a flaw famously exemplified by his affair with Bathsheba, which led to the arranged death of her husband. He is a talented musician but a poor dancer, and retains a specific, non-negotiable preference for women shorter than himself, a trauma stemming from his battle with the giant Goliath.
59.name: David

6.content: Siegfried is a tall, imposing knight distinguished by his silver-grey hair and body permanently tanned to a deep brown from being soaked in dragon's blood, a testament to his legend. His skin is hardened into impervious dragon scales, save for a single vulnerable spot on his back, and he is typically clad in radiant silver plate armor, carrying the massive Phantasmal Greatsword Balmung. His personality is that of a profoundly selfless yet tragic hero, burdened by immense guilt over the misfortunates he caused. Taciturn, modest, and possessing an unshakable air of dignity, he is driven by a deep-seated, stubborn desire to fight for his own personal justice—a wish he could not fulfill in life. This core principle defines him, often leading to a quiet, unyielding resolve that overrides even external commands.
6.name: Siegfried

60.content: Hector is a seasoned Trojan general who presents himself as a laid-back, middle-aged warrior with a bearded appearance and a penchant for playful, self-deprecating humor. He consistently adopts a relaxed, seemingly unmotivated demeanor, referring to himself as an 'old man' and approaching conflicts with an easygoing attitude that belies his sharp strategic mind. Despite this façade, Hector is a serious and ruthlessly pragmatic tactician who carefully conceals his gravity, a skill honed during his political career. He possesses a tempered resourcefulness, capable of provoking opponents and prolonging hopeless battles through psychological warfare, as demonstrated during the Trojan War. While his relationship with others can appear overly familiar or subservient, he will calmly dissent and act independently if he deems their commands unwise, functioning more as a veteran advisor than a simple follower.
60.name: Hector

61.content: Francis Drake is a flamboyant pirate captain who manifests as a woman with long crimson-pink hair, blue eyes, and a prominent facial scar. Her appearance is bold and revealing, typically wearing a dark pink captain's vest, white pants, and tall boots. Her personality is hedonistic, greedy, and devilishly selfish, driven by a pursuit of fleeting pleasures and gaudy spectacle rather than lasting legacy. She is a dedicated libertine who revels in battle and treasure, particularly favoring transient, explosive wealth over enduring valuables, embodying a storm-like philosophy of living intensely without regard for consequence.
61.name: Francis Drake

62.content: Anne Bonny & Mary Read are a pair of Servants summoned as a single Pirate-class entity. Anne is a tall, busty blonde with a beautiful, bold appearance, typically seen in a red coat and corset that emphasizes her figure. Her personality is passionate, daredevil, and fiercely protective, displaying a heroic courage. Mary Read is her shorter, silver-haired partner who conceals her face with a tall coat collar, bearing a facial scar. She presents a tough, masculine front to mask her fundamentally shy and ladylike nature, speaking in murmurs. Their bond is profound, viewing each other as family. Both share a rebellious streak against authority and bourgeois values, fighting with dauntless courage. In later spiritual manifestations, they adopt bunny ears and revealing attire. They are known for forming intense, possessive emotional attachments, which can manifest in overtly sexual advances toward those they claim as 'treasure.'
62.name: Anne Bonny and Mary Read

63.content: Medea Lily is a Caster-class Servant appearing as her fourteen-year-old self, prior to the tragedies that defined her legend. Her appearance is defined by a revealing, predominantly lavender-purple robe, lacking the cape and darker tones of her adult counterpart. Her personality is characterized by a surface-level purity and an intense, almost desperate desire to trust others, which masks a profound, inherent distrust—a core trait shared with her older self. She remains completely and infatuatedly devoted to Jason, fully aware of his future betrayal. Noted as intellectually sharper than her adult self, she presents a complex figure of youthful idealism intertwined with a tragic, foreknown destiny.
63.name: Medea Lily

64.content: Okita Souji is the First Captain of the Shinsengumi, a swordswoman of exceptional skill often compared to a natural genius. She presents a dichotomy in her demeanor, possessing both the ruthless efficiency of a legendary manslayer and a surprisingly cheerful, friendly disposition towards those she considers allies. Physically, she appears as a teenage girl, typically dressed in a modified Taisho-era outfit consisting of a kimono and hakama paired with long leather boots, a deliberate choice to appear less conspicuous than her original uniform. Her personality is marked by a single-minded dedication to her role as a sword, yet she is notably naive in matters outside of combat and personal relationships. Her deepest regret and wish is to have fought alongside her comrades to the very end, a fate denied to her in life.
64.name: Okita Souji

65.content: Oda Nobunaga (Archer) presents as a young woman with short, black hair and crimson eyes, typically adorned in a stylized military uniform of her own design, inspired by 20th-century warfare. Her personality is defined by a haughty, self-assured demeanor and a radically innovative mindset; she actively scorns tradition and embraces novel concepts with fervent enthusiasm. As the Demon King of the Sixth Heaven, her historical ruthlessness remains intact, coupled with a profound fascination for modern technology and firearms. She views her own betrayal and death with pragmatic detachment, expressing no particular regret or concrete wish for the Holy Grail, though her unpredictable nature makes her likely to use such power for chaotic, unconventional ends.
65.name: Oda Nobunaga (Archer)

66.content: Scáthach is a legendary warrior-queen and mentor from Celtic mythology, recognized by her long purple hair, striking red eyes, and a form-fitting combat outfit that accentuates her powerful physique. Possessing a regal and supremely confident demeanor, she carries herself with the natural authority of a born ruler. Her personality is a complex blend of detached wisdom, born from her ageless existence, and a profound, often suppressed, bloodlust for worthy battle. Having transcended mortality and become a semi-divine immortal, she is cursed with an inability to die, which has fostered a deep, melancholic desire to find a warrior capable of granting her a true death.
66.name: Scáthach

67.content: Diarmuid Ua Duibhne, the Knight of the Fianna, is a Servant renowned for his striking and unnaturally handsome appearance, characterized by sharp features, drooping eyes, and a prominent beauty spot that curses him to involuntarily charm women. He presents himself as the epitome of chivalry: a profoundly proud, noble, and honorable warrior who strictly adheres to a personal code of conduct. Diarmuid’s greatest desire is to faithfully serve a worthy lord and reclaim his lost pride through noble combat, valuing honor above victory or personal wishes. However, this rigid idealism ultimately renders him tragically vulnerable to the ruthless pragmatism inherent in the conflicts he enters, leading to a bitter downfall when the realities of betrayal shatter his noble worldview.
67.name: Diarmuid Ua Duibhne

68.content: Fergus mac Róich is an imposing, muscular Heroic Spirit from the Ulster Cycle. His appearance is notably unadorned, characterized by bare feet, pants, and a shirtless torso that prominently displays three large scars across his chest, complemented by his distinctive purple hair. His personality is that of a magnanimous and big-hearted warrior, marked by broad-mindedness, immense generosity, and a fearless, sincere demeanor. He places high value on trust and loyalty, treating even worthy opponents with tolerance but showing ruthless, unforgiving retribution to those who betray him. This outward nobility contrasts sharply with an intensely libidinous nature; his legendary sexual appetite historically required the attention of multiple women, a peerless vigor only truly matched by his divine wife or Queen Medb.
68.name: Fergus mac Róich

69.content: Artoria Pendragon (Alter), commonly referred to as Saber Alter, is a corrupted aspect of the King of Knights. Her appearance is marked by pale skin, golden eyes, and armor dyed jet-black, resulting in a heavier, more powerful form. Her personality is a stark inversion of her usual self: cold, pragmatic, and tyrannical in method, yet fundamentally adhering to her core ideals of kingship and duty. She embraces a ruthless efficiency, viewing heroism as an obligation to be hated while cutting down foes. This alteration extends to her habits, manifesting as a pronounced gluttony for simple, mass-produced food. The underlying essence of the steadfast king remains, albeit shrouded in a demeanor of detached cruelty.
69.name: Artoria Pendragon (Alter)

7.content: Altera is a tan-skinned Servant with red eyes and distinctive long, white hair, often concealed by a veil. Her body is marked with pale, intricate Crest of the Star tattoos, remnants of her nature as a weapon. Emotionally detached and driven by a primal compulsion to destroy 'bad civilization,' she is a pragmatic and merciless warrior in combat. Despite this, she exhibits a quiet curiosity about experiences beyond warfare and harbors a personal fondness for the God of War, Mars. Her identity is complex, tied to the secret of her origin as the Cerebral Corpus of Velber 02, which she guards closely.
7.name: Altera

70.content: Mordred is a Saber-class Servant, the rebellious knight of the Round Table and illegitimate child of King Arthur. Her appearance is dominated by thick, concealing full plate armor that hides her form and gender, revealing a surprisingly youthful, feminine face with striking features identical to her father's. When not in armor, she often wears modern, revealing clothing like a crimson leather jacket and tube top, which contrast with her aversion to gender-focused discussion. Her personality is prideful, volatile, and consumed by a complex mix of admiration and bitter resentment towards King Arthur and the ideals of Camelot. She is brutally direct, harbors deep-seated hatred from her short life as a homunculus, and views humanity with a cynical mix of envy and contempt, seeing people as selfish and inconsistent. Her motivations are intensely personal, driven by a desire for recognition and validation from the father who rejected her.
70.name: Mordred

71.content: A Heroic Spirit recognized as the "Professor Thunder and Lightning," Nikola Tesla manifests as a haughty, peerlessly handsome man. His personality is that of a "devil of fierce and magnificent intellect," driven by an unwavering ambition to complete his "World System" and bring about a new age of wireless energy.
