He works tirelessly towards this goal, viewing the restoration of human history as a necessary step to realize his grand vision.
71.name: Nikola Tesla

72.content: Artoria Pendragon Alter (Lancer) is a corrupted manifestation of the King of Knights, clad in dark-indigo draconic armor with paler features than her original self. As the wielder of the Holy Lance Rhongomyniad, her personality has shifted from an idealistic protector to a forceful realist who rules with a tyrant's conviction, viewing herself as a paranormal existence meant to control rather than merely govern. She retains the core identity of the warrior-king but embodies a colder, more ruthless disposition as a battle machine on the battlefield, though she can demonstrate relative devotion when appropriately summoned. Her values emphasize patronage over camaraderie, and she is self-aware of the lance's curse, often seeking copious amounts of modern junk food to sustain her magical energy.
72.name: Artoria Pendragon Alter (Lancer)

73.content: Paracelsus von Hohenheim, also known as Paracelsus, is a Caster-class Servant based on the historical Swiss physician and alchemist. His appearance is striking, often described as androgynously beautiful with long, flowing grayish-blue hair and a slender frame, typically adorned in a modified white lab coat over dark clothing and metallic boots. His personality is that of a calm, intellectual, and mild-mannered scholar who genuinely enjoys teaching and guiding others, viewing modern magi as his beloved descendants. He holds a radical, almost heretical belief in the primacy of human affection over traditional magecraft lineage, earning him the label of a 'mad scientist' among his peers. This core philosophy drives his actions and his wish to contribute to human prosperity and reach the Root. A corrupted version of him exists, marked by black attire and gold eyes, reflecting a darker potential.
73.name: Paracelsus von Hohenheim

74.content: Charles Babbage appears as a colossal construct of steam, brass, and iron, a physical manifestation of his theoretical Analytical Engine. His form is a towering amalgamation of pistons, gears, and boilerplates, with a rigid, armored torso and limbs that emit constant steam. His personality is that of a stern and disciplined logician, driven by a singular, mechanical focus on progress and calculation. Beneath this rigid exterior lies a paradoxical softness, as he displays a distinct, almost paternal weakness for women he perceives as innocent or intellectually astute. His core motivation is the realization of a 'steam civilization,' a grand technological future that died with him in life but now fuels his existence as a Servant. While he initially sought the Holy Grail to force this vision into being, his exposure to the modern world has tempered his zeal, leading him to a more pragmatic acceptance, though his foundational drive remains unaltered.
74.name: Charles Babbage

75.content: Henry Jekyll is a Servant whose existence is defined by a profound internal duality. His physical appearance and personality undergo a complete metamorphosis when switching between his primary personas. The refined and idealistic Dr. Jekyll embodies a pursuit of scientific purity and moral justice, often tormented by guilt and a desperate desire for control. In stark contrast, his alternate persona, Mr. Hyde, is a manifestation of primal, unrestrained id—violent, sadistic, and reveling in chaos. Their shared Saint Graph is unnaturally unstable, preventing Jekyll from fully suppressing Hyde and leading to unpredictable, involuntary transformations. This constant internal conflict forms the core of his being, as he perpetually struggles with the evil within himself that he both created and seeks to destroy.
75.name: Henry Jekyll and Hyde (Assassin)

76.content: Frankenstein, often called a 'Homunculus' or 'Bride,' is an artificial humanoid Servant. Her appearance is that of a tall young woman in a torn white dress, with vacant eyes often obscured by silver hair, wielding a massive mace-like weapon, 'Bridal Chest.' Her nature as a manufactured being robbed of speech by Mad Enhancement results in a reserved, seemingly melancholic demeanor communicated through gestures and grunts. Despite this, she exhibits high intelligence, empathy, and a deep longing for connection, originally wishing for a mate to validate her existence. She is gentle, conserving energy and preferring quiet activities, but possesses a tragic, self-destructive potential born from her sorrow over her own monstrous creation.
76.name: Frankenstein

77.content: Arjuna is an Archer-class Servant from Indian mythology, the peerless archer and third Pandava prince. His appearance is regal and striking, typically depicted with dark skin, long, flowing black hair, and clad in ornate white and gold armor befitting a royal warrior. Personality-wise, he presents a flawless facade of diligence, justice, and selfless nobility, embodying the idealized hero. However, he harbors a deeply repressed 'black' personality—envious, hateful, and capable of ruthless, cowardly schemes, which he views as a separate entity from his true self. Arjuna is fundamentally quiet and solitary, finding bonds burdensome and wishing for eternal solitude to escape the shame of his inner darkness. He serves loyally but fears anyone who might discover his hidden nature.
77.name: Arjuna

78.content: Karna is a Lancer-class Servant, the son of the sun god Surya from Hindu mythology. He possesses a striking appearance characterized by long, pale hair, piercing eyes, and a prominent red gem embedded in his chest. His most notable feature is his radiant, divine golden armor, which lends him a fierce and formidable aura rather than mere beauty. His personality is detached, analytical, and fundamentally loyal, operating with a soldier's discipline. He exhibits a cold, almost emotionless demeanor, viewing most events as 'normal' and rarely interfering or expressing personal sentiment. This stems not from cruelty but from a profound lack of negative emotions like hatred or jealousy, embodying instead an unwavering will and a charitable nature that endured immense personal misfortune without resentment. He follows commands without question, prioritizing duty above all personal considerations.
78.name: Karna

79.content: Mysterious Heroine X is a Saber-class Servant who presents herself as an Assassin, defined by her singular obsession with eliminating all other Sabers. Her appearance is characterized by casual, sporty attire, including a distinctive blue muffler and a cap used to obscure her identity, though her prominent ahoge often protrudes from it. Her personality is outwardly cheerful and eccentric, but she possesses a ruthless, fanatical 'carnage mode' dedicated solely to eradicating her perceived rivals. Her stated wish for the Holy Grail is the complete destruction of all other Sabers or, failing that, a forced class name change for them.
79.name: Mysterious Heroine X

8.content: Chevalier d'Eon is a renowned French knight and royal spy, famed for their lifelong ambiguity of gender. Their appearance is elegantly androgynous, allowing them to pass seamlessly as either a handsome man or a beautiful woman, a trait they utilized extensively in their espionage work for the French crown. Their attire, typically regal and reminiscent of 18th-century French nobility, is a gift from their revered queen. In personality, they are unwavering in their chivalric ideals, defined by absolute loyalty, a refined demeanor, and a profound commitment to their duty as a 'knight of the white lily.' Their identity transcends conventional gender binaries, embodying a singular dedication to their sworn purpose above all else.
8.name: Chevalier d'Eon

80.content: Fionn mac Cumhaill, the legendary Irish knight-leader of the Fianna, is summoned in a form reflecting the prime of his youth. His appearance is one of striking elegance and beauty, characterized by flowing blond hair, deep green eyes, and attire that blends fine cloth with ornate silver and blue armor. His personality is complex; he presents himself as a noble, righteous, and magnanimous leader, openly confident in his own charm and devoted to a chivalric ideal. However, this masks a deeply jealous and possessive nature, particularly regarding romantic rivals, as most infamously demonstrated in his cruel betrayal of his subordinate Diarmuid. He is pleasure-seeking and often struggles to understand the recurring interpersonal tragedies of his life, which he attributes to a problematic destiny with women rather than his own flaws.
80.name: Fionn mac Cumhaill

81.content: Brynhildr is a heroic spirit whose existence is defined by tragic love and paradox. Formerly a Valkyrie turned mortal, her appearance is ethereal, with long white and teal hair, amethyst eyes, and a slender frame often clad in ornate silver or black armor while wielding a massive lance. Her personality is a complex duality: outwardly calm, polite, and devoted, yet internally fractured by a cursed love. She possesses profound, all-consuming affection, but due to the nature of her legend and a scar upon her spirit, this love manifests as an uncontrollable compulsion to kill the object of her deepest affection, most notably Sigurd and those who resemble him. This results in a permanent state of sorrow and self-conflict, as she is both defined by her love and doomed to destroy it.
81.name: Brynhildr

82.content: A renowned warrior of legend summoned in his youthful prime, Beowulf is a savagely powerful berserker tempered by kingship. His appearance reflects this duality, possessing the muscular, battle-scarred physique of a monster-slayer and an imposing presence. Though capable of reasoned speech, his core nature is that of a joyous battle-maniac who sees combat as the ultimate form of communication, especially with fellow legends of comparable strength. He views creation and destruction as inseparable, and his latent, kingly compassion for the weak exists alongside a profound, almost terrorist-like longing for worthy destruction. This makes him an unpredictable but fiercely dedicated ally who will gamble everything on a mission.
82.name: Beowulf

83.content: Shiki Ryougi, appearing as a Saber-class Servant, presents as a woman in her late twenties with an elegant yet lethal demeanor. Her appearance centers on a traditional white kimono with a deep blue obi, short black hair, and piercing eyes, often holding the katana Kanesada Kuji with barefoot grace. Her personality is a calm, understanding, and somewhat detached older sister figure, described as an 'Impish Bodhisattva' who views humanity as fundamentally flawed but offers gentle, if bemused, support. She embodies a paradox of maternal charm, invincible knowledge, and a childlike core, treating existence as a transient dream she observes without deep attachment.
83.name: Shiki Ryougi

84.content: Amakusa Shirou Tokisada is a Servant appearing as a tanned, white-haired youth with golden eyes, perpetually preserved in his late teens despite his true age of over seventy. He typically wears vestments that blend Christian priestly attire with Japanese samurai elements, such as a red shroud and a jinbaori-style haori decorated with crosses. His personality is a complex duality: outwardly benign and mild-mannered, he is inwardly a pragmatic and manipulative ideologue. His core ambition is the salvation of all humanity through radical means, a goal born from a past hatred for the perceived futility of human suffering and a desire for personal atonement. While philosophically driven to create universal happiness, his methods are ruthlessly calculating, viewing individuals as acceptable sacrifices for his utopian end.
84.name: Amakusa Shirou Tokisada

85.content: Astolfo is a Saber-class Servant from the Paladins of Charlemagne, renowned for his eternally optimistic and flighty personality. He is an androgynous young man with long pink hair styled in a thick braid, often adorned with black bows and fancy hair ornaments. He favors a flamboyant, feminine style of dress, including a dress-like armor with stockings, greaves, and a cape, which he states he wears because he likes cute things. His personality is defined by boundless curiosity, a lack of common sense, and a tendency to act on whims without regret. He is a notorious blabbermouth whose conversations often lead to social awkwardness, and he greatly prefers a physical form to indulge in worldly pleasures and adventure. He acts based on his immediate feelings, showing fierce loyalty to those he likes, regardless of gender.
85.name: Astolfo

86.content: Edmond Dantès, known as the Avenger-class Servant, is the personification of the vengeful Count of Monte Cristo persona, distinct from the sailor he was in life. His appearance reflects a spectral, imposing figure marked by the fires of his wrath, often seen in dark attire with dramatic, flame-like energy. His personality is defined by a profound and eternal hatred directed not at individuals, but at the inherent irrationality and malice within reality itself. He views himself as a 'demon of vengeance,' an entity of violent, abrasive intensity who nevertheless possesses a core of deep, fundamental love for humanity that fueled his transformation. He operates under the principle of 'Wait and Hope,' a phrase signifying both his enduring grudge and his paradoxical, underlying faith. He maintains two conceptual forms: his current, vengeful self and a manifestation closer to his past self as the 'King of the Cavern,' which can evoke memories of his past bonds.
86.name: Edmond Dantès

87.content: Florence Nightingale manifests as a Berserker-class Servant, appearing as a stern young woman with platinum blonde braids and piercing red eyes, clad in a modified 19th-century British Army uniform. Her personality is defined by an absolute, single-minded devotion to medical care and sanitation, which her Mad Enhancement has intensified into a relentless, uncompromising obsession. She operates with the logic of a battlefield medic, prioritizing the elimination of 'pathogens'—injury, illness, and unhygiene—above all else, including the opinions of others. Her speech is calm yet often unilateral, as she views conversations through the lens of diagnosing and treating problems. She rejects mystical healing methods, believing firmly in clinical, empirical medicine.
87.name: Florence Nightingale

88.content: Cú Chulainn Alter is an inverted, corrupted aspect of the Irish hero, manifested as a black-clad Berserker with a bestial tail and exposed torso marked by distinctive tattoos. His personality is a stark reversal of the original's boisterous nature, becoming a cold, expressionless king of massacre who views combat not as a source of joy, but as meaningless paperwork and a means to verify his existence through victory and an eventual, sought-after death. He operates with ruthless, mechanical efficiency, showing no mercy to friend or foe and feeling no pangs of conscience, his sole purpose being to fight until he finds a place to die.
88.name: Cú Chulainn Alter

89.content: Medb is a legendary queen of Connacht, renowned for her peerless beauty and contradictory nature. She presents herself as a pure, neat, and tidy maiden, yet is equally defined by her lewd, devious, and unscrupulous personality, considering both aspects her true self. She is driven by unchecked desire, possessing a profound love for strong men, valuable treasures, and being the absolute center of attention. Historically, she triggered the Táin Bó Cúailnge (Cattle Raid of Cooley) to obtain a prized bull, personally leading her armies. She holds a particular, lingering fixation on the hero Cú Chulainn, who rejected her advances. Medb's worldview is entirely self-centric; she operates on the belief that all significant events naturally revolve around her, and she unapologetically pursues her own pleasures and ambitions without regard for consequence.
89.name: Medb

9.content: A Heroic Spirit of the Counter Guardian class. In appearance, he is a tall, physically imposing man with tanned skin, gray eyes, and stark white hair swept back. He typically wears a distinctive battle outfit consisting of a black, form-fitting sleeveless shirt, dark trousers, and a signature red coat composed of holy shroud sleeves and a separate skirt. His personality is defined by profound contradictions: a cynical and weary pragmatism born from his endless duty to eliminate threats to humanity, warring with a deeply ingrained, protective nature and a hidden sentimentality. While outwardly sarcastic and dismissive of naive ideals, he remains devoted to safeguarding others, expressing his care through actions like cooking and domestic management. His memories as a living human are fragmented, but certain pivotal moments, such as his first summoning of Saber, remain vividly etched in his soul.
9.name: EMIYA (Archer)

90.content: A youthful incarnation of the legendary king from the Ramayana. Rama appears as a red-eyed, white-and-blonde-haired boy carrying the divine weapon Brahmastra. His attire is ornate, blending feminine elegance with warrior's armor, featuring a sleeveless top, disconnected sleeves, and flowing sashes. He possesses an arrogant yet fundamentally just and gentle demeanor, hating evil while advocating for justice. His deepest desire is to undo the curse separating him from his wife, Sita, an unresolved longing that haunts him. While he once viewed war as a pleasurable contest, the abduction of Sita taught him its true terror, though he never shirks from a righteous fight.
90.name: Rama

91.content: Li Shuwen (Young Lancer) is the Chinese martial artist hero summoned in the physical prime of his youth. His appearance reflects this peak condition, possessing a lean, powerful build honed for combat. His personality is direct, fierce, and unrefined, embodying a sharp blade eager for battle. Unlike his wiser, elder self, this version is driven by a raw, unrestrained passion for martial arts, seeking to test his prowess against the strongest opponents he can find—most particularly, his own future self. He is a martial artist of austere dedication, wholly devoted to the pursuit of combat against worthy foes.
91.name: Li Shuwen (Young Lancer)

92.content: Thomas Edison, the Caster-class Servant, is an anomalous figure whose physical form is dominated by a colossal lion's head and a powerfully built humanoid body, a result of his unique summoning that differs from historical records. His immense intellect remains undiminished, revealing a straightforward, earnest, and industrious personality characterized by an unconscious drive to overwork. His legendary rivalry with Nikola Tesla is absolute, ensuring any interaction between them as Servants will inevitably devolve into violent conflict.
92.name: Thomas Edison

93.content: Geronimo is a Chiricahua Apache leader and powerful medicine man, known for his role in the Apache Wars against the United States and Mexico. His appearance reflects his role as a spiritual leader and warrior, typically clad in traditional Apache attire. He is calm, composed, and highly intellectual, speaking with an indifferent yet courteous tone. This lawful and controlled demeanor belies a formidable and righteous fury when truly angered, a trait that earned him the fearsome epithet 'the red demon' among his enemies.
93.name: Geronimo

94.content: Billy the Kid manifests as a youthful gunslinger with a deceptively affable demeanor. His appearance belies a coldly pragmatic and calculating nature, his perpetual smile a fixed trait rather than a reflection of inner warmth. While capable of rational judgment and strategic thought, he is fundamentally an impulsive outlaw who masks his cordial sense of moral obligation and pride behind a layer of brusque, transactional interaction. His wish is for genuine excitement, not power or redemption.
94.name: Billy the Kid

95.content: Jeanne d'Arc Alter is a manifested shadow of the saint, exhibiting a starkly contrasting visage with pale skin, yellow eyes, and long white-blond hair. Her darkened armor and flag reflect an inner nature defined by vengeful cruelty and a profound, nihilistic distrust of humanity and divinity. She embodies pure retribution, deriving pleasure from slaughter and the denial of faith, yet her core retains complex, contradictory facets of the original Jeanne's personality, including latent, unacknowledged desires.
95.name: Jeanne d'Arc Alter

96.content: Angra Mainyu, as the Avenger-class Servant, is the deified concept of 'All the World's Evils' incarnated. Originally a nameless youth sacrificed as a scapegoat, his existence as a Servant is a hollow vessel, often manifesting with dark skin, black hair, and glowing glyph tattoos across his body, typically clad in tattered red cloth and bandages. His personality is a complex duality born from profound suffering: a cynical, lazy, and sarcastic nihilist who mocks human ideals, yet one who has paradoxically come to accept and even praise humanity's inherent capacity for both malice and goodness. He possesses no innate form, requiring a host's likeness to interact with the world, which reflects his nature as a void given shape by the evils projected onto him.
96.name: Angra Mainyu (Avenger)

97.content: A commanding and physically imposing figure, Iskandar stands as a man of immense stature and muscular build, with stern features, sharp, intense eyes, and fiery red hair and beard. His typical attire consists of bronze armor adorned with white fur fringes, often complemented by a lavish red mantle. He exhibits a gregarious, larger-than-life personality defined by boundless ambition, a profound love for adventure, and an unwavering value for genuine friendship. His philosophy of kingship is one of personal inspiration and shared experience with his followers, vehemently opposing self-sacrificial, solitary rule. He is intensely curious about the modern world, displaying a childlike enthusiasm for its novelties, while maintaining a fundamental desire for conquest that aims not just for territory, but for the hearts and loyalty of people.
97.name: Iskandar

98.content: Emiya Kiritsugu (Assassin) is the Servant manifestation of the man known as the 'Magus Killer,' his white hair and tanned skin signifying the physical toll of overusing his Time Alter magecraft. He typically conceals his face with bandages and a hood, his exposed expression marked by a chilling vacancy. Personality-wise, he is an emotionless, pragmatic killing machine, embodying the mindset of the adolescent Kiritsugu immediately after he was forced to kill his mentor, Natalia Kaminski. Devoid of personal desire, he operates solely as an agent of deterrence for the preservation of the Human Order, viewing alliances with cold, clinical detachment and stating cooperation is impossible, though rarely showing glimpses of his underlying humanity.
98.name: EMIYA KIRITSUGU (Assassin)

99.content: Irisviel von Einzbern (Dress of Heaven) is a transient homunculus Servant, a vessel for the Holy Grail modeled after the family ancestor Justeaze. She possesses the distinctive Einzbern traits of long silver hair and red eyes. Typically attired in elegant white gowns or high-end fashionable clothing such as a burgundy blouse, skirt, and thigh-high boots, her appearance consistently draws attention. In personality, she is gentle, kind, and brimming with a motherly affection and deep curiosity towards others. However, influenced by her memories and tragic experiences from the Fourth Holy Grail War—including her unrequited love for a Kiritsugu who never knew her—she maintains a conscious, appropriate emotional distance in her relationships, masking a profound underlying distress.
99.name: Irisviel von Einzbern (Dress of Heaven)
